title.zh: 卷一百〇一 志第五十四 禮四
title.raw: 卷一百〇一 志第五十四 禮四 Volume 101 Treatises 54: Rites 4

sentences.zh: 明堂。

translations.literal: The Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: The Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 宋初，雖有季秋大享之文，然未嘗親祠，命有司攝事而已。

translations.literal: Early in Song, although there were prescriptions for the autumn grand offering, the emperor never personally sacrificed, ordering the relevant offices to act on his behalf only.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Song, although the autumn grand offering was prescribed in the regulations, no emperor ever performed the rite in person; the relevant offices were always ordered to handle the ceremony on his behalf.

sentences.zh: 真宗始議行之，屬封岱宗、祀汾陰，故亦未遑。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhenzong first deliberated carrying it out, but it happened to coincide with the feng at Mount Tai and the sacrifice at Fenyin, so there was no leisure for it either.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhenzong was the first to consider implementing the rite, but the feng at Mount Tai and the sacrifice at Fenyin intervened, so he too had no opportunity to carry it out.

sentences.zh: 皇祐二年三月，仁宗謂輔臣：「今年冬至日，當親祀圜丘，欲以季秋行大享明堂禮。

translations.literal: In the third month of Huangyou 2, Emperor Renzong told his chief ministers: "This year on the winter solstice I should personally sacrifice at the Round Mound; I wish to perform the autumn grand offering at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Huangyou 2 (1050), Emperor Renzong told his chief ministers: "On this year's winter solstice I intend to sacrifice personally at the Round Mound, and I wish to perform the autumn grand offering at the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 然自漢以來，諸儒各為論議，駁而不同。

translations.literal: Yet since Han, the various Confucians each offered their own discussions, refuting one another and not agreeing.
translations.idiomatic: Yet since the Han, scholars had offered competing interpretations that refuted one another and never agreed.

sentences.zh: 夫明堂者，布政之宮，朝諸侯之位，天子之路寢，乃今之大慶殿也。

translations.literal: The Bright Hall is the palace for promulgating government, the place for receiving the feudal lords, the Son of Heaven's inner sleeping quarters—it is today's Great Felicity Hall.
translations.idiomatic: The Bright Hall was the hall for promulgating government, the seat for receiving feudal lords, and the Son of Heaven's inner sleeping quarters—in our day, the Great Felicity Hall.

sentences.zh: 況明道初合祀天地於此，今之親祀，不當因循，尚於郊壝寓祭也。

translations.literal: Moreover, at the beginning of Mingdao Heaven and Earth were jointly sacrificed here; today's personal sacrifice should not follow precedent and still perform a surrogate sacrifice at the suburban altar mound.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, at the beginning of the Mingdao era Heaven and Earth had been sacrificed here together; for today's personal sacrifice we should not simply follow precedent and still hold a surrogate rite at the suburban altar mound.

sentences.zh: 其以大慶殿為明堂，分五室於內。」

translations.literal: Take the Great Felicity Hall as the Bright Hall and divide five chambers within it."
translations.idiomatic: Let the Great Felicity Hall serve as the Bright Hall, with five chambers divided within it."

sentences.zh: 仍詔所司詳定儀注以聞。

translations.literal: He also ordered the relevant offices to work out the ritual regulations in detail and report.
translations.idiomatic: He also ordered the relevant offices to work out the ritual regulations in detail and report back.

sentences.zh: 禮院請依《周禮》，設五室於大慶殿。

translations.literal: The Ritual Academy requested following the Zhou Rites and establishing five chambers in the Great Felicity Hall.
translations.idiomatic: The Ritual Academy requested that, following the Zhou Rites, five chambers be established in the Great Felicity Hall.

sentences.zh: 舊禮，明堂五帝位皆為幔室。

translations.literal: Under the old rites, the Bright Hall positions of the Five Emperors were all curtained chambers.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old rites, the Bright Hall positions for the Five Emperors were all curtained chambers.

sentences.zh: 今旁帷上幕，宜用青繒朱裏；

translations.literal: Now for the side curtains and upper drapes, blue silk with vermilion lining should be used;
translations.idiomatic: For the side curtains and upper drapes, blue silk with vermilion lining should be used;

sentences.zh: 四戶八牖，赤綴戶，白綴牖，宜飾以朱白繒。

translations.literal: four doors and eight windows, vermilion-trimmed doors and white-trimmed windows—vermilion and white silk should be used for decoration.
translations.idiomatic: the four doors and eight windows, with vermilion-trimmed doors and white-trimmed windows, should be decorated with vermilion and white silk.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「祖宗親郊，合祭天地，祖宗並配，百神從祀。

translations.literal: An edict said: "The ancestors personally performed suburban sacrifice, jointly sacrificing Heaven and Earth, with the ancestors all as associates, and the hundred spirits following in sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "Our ancestors performed suburban sacrifice in person, jointly sacrificing Heaven and Earth with all ancestors as associates and the hundred spirits in attendance.

sentences.zh: 今祀明堂，正當親郊之期，而禮官所定，祭天不及地祇，配坐不及祖宗，未合三朝之制。

translations.literal: Now sacrificing at the Bright Hall falls exactly in the period of personal suburban sacrifice, yet what the ritual officials fixed—sacrificing to Heaven without reaching Earth Almighty, associate seats without reaching the ancestors—does not accord with the regulations of the three reigns.
translations.idiomatic: The present Bright Hall sacrifice coincides with the period for personal suburban sacrifice, yet the ritual officials' plan sacrificed to Heaven without including Earth Almighty and provided associate seats without including the ancestors—this did not accord with the practice of the three reigns.

sentences.zh: 且移郊為大享，蓋亦為民祈福，宜合祭皇地祇，奉太祖、太宗、真宗並配，而五帝、神州亦親獻之。

translations.literal: Moreover, shifting the suburban sacrifice to the grand offering is also to seek blessings for the people on their behalf; Imperial Earth Almighty should be jointly sacrificed, with Taizu, Taizong, and Zhenzong all as associates, and the Five Emperors and Divine Land should also be personally offered.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, shifting the suburban sacrifice to the grand offering was likewise to seek blessings for the people; Imperial Earth Almighty should be sacrificed jointly, with Taizu, Taizong, and Zhenzong all as associates, and the Five Emperors and Divine Land should also receive personal offerings from the emperor.

sentences.zh: 日、月、河、海諸神，悉如圜丘從祀之數。」

translations.literal: The spirits of Sun, Moon, rivers, and seas—all according to the number of attendant sacrifices at the Round Mound."
translations.idiomatic: The spirits of the Sun, Moon, rivers, and seas should all follow the number of attendant sacrifices at the Round Mound."

sentences.zh: 禮官議諸神位未決，帝諭文彥博等曰：「郊壇第一龕者在堂，第二、第三龕設於左右夾廡及龍墀上，在壝內外者，列於堂東西廂及後廡，以象壇壝之制。

translations.literal: The ritual officials deliberated on the spirit positions without reaching a decision; the emperor instructed Wen Yanbo and others: "The first niche of the suburban altar is in the hall; the second and third niches are set in the left and right side corridors and on the dragon terrace; those inside and outside the altar mound are arrayed in the east and west wings and rear corridor of the hall, to mirror the altar-mound arrangement.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officials could not agree on the spirit positions; the emperor instructed Wen Yanbo and others: "The first niche of the suburban altar should be in the main hall; the second and third niches in the left and right side corridors and on the dragon terrace; those corresponding to positions inside and outside the altar mound should be arrayed in the east and west wings and rear corridor, mirroring the altar-mound layout.

sentences.zh: 仍先繢圖。」

translations.literal: First draw the diagram as well."
translations.idiomatic: Draw the diagram first as well."

sentences.zh: 令輔臣、禮官視設神位。

translations.literal: He ordered the chief ministers and ritual officials to inspect the setting of spirit positions.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the chief ministers and ritual officials to inspect the arrangement of the spirit positions.

sentences.zh: 昊天上帝，堂下山罍各四。

translations.literal: August Heaven Supreme Lord: four mountain wine vessels each below the hall.
translations.idiomatic: For August Heaven Supreme Lord: four mountain wine vessels below the hall.

sentences.zh: 皇地祇，大尊、著尊、犧尊、山罍各二，在堂上室外神坐左；

translations.literal: Imperial Earth Almighty: two each of the large, secondary, sacrificial, and mountain wine vessels, to the left of the spirit seat outside the hall above;
translations.idiomatic: For Imperial Earth Almighty: two each of the large, secondary, sacrificial, and mountain wine vessels, placed to the left of the spirit seat outside the upper hall;

sentences.zh: 象尊二，壺尊二，山罍四，在堂下中陛東。

translations.literal: two elephant-shaped vessels, two jar vessels, four mountain vessels, east of the central steps below the hall.
translations.idiomatic: two elephant-shaped vessels, two jar vessels, and four mountain vessels, east of the central steps below the hall.

sentences.zh: 三配帝、五方帝，山罍各二，於室外神坐左。

translations.literal: The three associate emperors and Five Directional Emperors: two mountain vessels each, to the left of the spirit seats outside the hall.
translations.idiomatic: For the three associate emperors and the Five Directional Emperors: two mountain vessels each, to the left of the spirit seats outside the hall.

sentences.zh: 神州，大尊、著尊、山罍各二，在堂上神坐左。

translations.literal: Divine Land: two each of large, secondary, and mountain vessels, to the left of the spirit seat in the hall above.
translations.idiomatic: For Divine Land: two each of the large, secondary, and mountain vessels, to the left of the spirit seat in the upper hall.

sentences.zh: 牲各用一犢，毛不能如其方，以純色代。

translations.literal: For victims each use one calf; if the coat cannot match its direction, substitute a solid-colored animal.
translations.idiomatic: For each victim use one calf; if the coat cannot match the required direction, substitute a solid-colored animal.

sentences.zh: 籩豆，數用大祠。

translations.literal: For platters and stands, use the number for a great sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: For platters and stands, use the count prescribed for a great sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 日、月、天皇大帝、北極，大尊各二，在殿上神坐左。

translations.literal: Sun, Moon, August Heaven Great Emperor, and North Pole: two large vessels each, to the left of the spirit seats on the upper hall.
translations.idiomatic: For the Sun, Moon, August Heaven Great Emperor, and North Pole: two large vessels each, to the left of the spirit seats on the upper hall.

sentences.zh: 籩豆，數用中祠。

translations.literal: For platters and stands, use the number for a medium sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: For platters and stands, use the count prescribed for a medium sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 五官，數用小祠。

translations.literal: For the Five Officials, use the number for a small sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: For the Five Officials, use the count prescribed for a small sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 內官，象尊各二，每方嶽、鎮、海、瀆，山尊各二，在堂左右。

translations.literal: Inner officials: two elephant-shaped vessels each; for each direction's peak, bulwark, sea, and river channel, two mountain vessels each, to the left and right of the hall.
translations.idiomatic: For inner officials: two elephant-shaped vessels each; for each direction's peak, bulwark, sea, and major river, two mountain vessels each, placed to the left and right of the hall.

sentences.zh: 中官，壺尊各二，在丹墀、龍墀上。

translations.literal: Middle officials: two jar vessels each, on the cinnabar terrace and dragon terrace.
translations.idiomatic: For middle officials: two jar vessels each, on the cinnabar terrace and dragon terrace.

sentences.zh: 外官，每方丘陵、墳衍、原隰，概尊各二，眾星，散尊各二，在東西廂神坐左右。

translations.literal: Outer officials: for each direction's hills, mounds, plains, and lowlands, two general vessels each; for the host of stars, two scattered vessels each, to the left and right of the spirit seats in the east and west wings.
translations.idiomatic: For outer officials: for each direction's hills, mounds, plains, and lowlands, two general vessels each; for the host of stars, two scattered vessels each, placed to the left and right of the spirit seats in the east and west wings.

sentences.zh: 配帝席蒲越，五人帝莞，北極以上稿秸加褥，五官、五星以下莞不加褥，餘如南郊。

translations.literal: Associate emperor seats use rush mats; the Five Human Emperors use cattail mats; from North Pole upward, straw with added cushions; Five Officials and Five Stars downward use cattail without added cushions—the rest as at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: Associate emperor seats used rush mats; the Five Human Emperors used cattail mats; from North Pole upward, straw with added cushions; Five Officials and Five Stars downward used cattail without cushions—the rest followed the Southern Suburb precedent.

sentences.zh: 景靈宮升降，置黃道褥位。

translations.literal: For ascending and descending at the Jingling Palace, set yellow-path cushion positions.
translations.idiomatic: For ascending and descending at the Jingling Palace, yellow-path cushion positions were set.

sentences.zh: 致齋日，陳法駕鹵簿儀仗，壝門大次之後設小次。

translations.literal: On the day of attaining purity, array the imperial guard of honor and ceremonial insignia; behind the great rest pavilion at the altar gate, set up the small rest pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On the day of ritual purification, the imperial guard of honor and ceremonial insignia were arrayed; behind the great rest pavilion at the altar gate, a small rest pavilion was set up.

sentences.zh: 知廟卿酌奠七祠，文臣分享奉慈、後廟，近侍宿朝堂。

translations.literal: The director of temple affairs poured offerings at seven shrines; civil officials shared in offering at Fengci and Houmiao; close attendants lodged in the audience hall.
translations.idiomatic: The director of temple affairs poured offerings at seven shrines; civil officials shared in offerings at Fengci and Houmiao; close attendants lodged in the audience hall.

sentences.zh: 行事及從升堂、百官分宿升龍門外，內庭省司宿本所，諸方客宿公館。

translations.literal: Those performing the rite and attendants ascending the hall, the hundred officials lodged separately outside the Ascending Dragon Gate; inner-palace offices lodged at their posts; guests from the regions lodged at the official residence.
translations.idiomatic: Those performing the rite and attendants who ascended the hall lodged separately outside the Ascending Dragon Gate; inner-palace offices lodged at their posts; guests from the regions lodged at the official residence.

sentences.zh: 設宿爟火於望燎位東南。

translations.literal: Set the overnight signal fire southeast of the outlook burning position.
translations.idiomatic: An overnight signal fire was set southeast of the outlook burning position.

sentences.zh: 牲增四犢，羊、豕依郊各十六，以薦從祀。

translations.literal: Victims increased by four calves; sheep and pigs according to the suburban sacrifice, sixteen each, to present for attendant sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Victims were increased by four calves; sheep and pigs followed the suburban sacrifice at sixteen each, to present for attendant sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 帝謂前代禮有祭玉、燔玉，今獨有燔玉，命擇良玉為琮、璧。

translations.literal: The emperor said that former ages' rites had offering jade and burning jade; now there is only burning jade—he ordered selecting fine jade for cong and bi disks.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor noted that former ages' rites included both offering jade and burning jade, whereas now only burning jade remained; he ordered fine jade selected for cong and bi disks.

sentences.zh: 皇地祇黃琮、黃幣，神州兩圭有邸、黑幣，日月圭、璧，皆置神坐前，燔玉加幣上。

translations.literal: Imperial Earth Almighty: yellow cong and yellow silks; Divine Land: two gui with pedestals and black silks; Sun and Moon: gui and bi—all placed before the spirit seats, burning jade placed atop the silks.
translations.idiomatic: For Imperial Earth Almighty: a yellow cong and yellow silks; for Divine Land: two gui with pedestals and black silks; for Sun and Moon: gui and bi—all placed before the spirit seats, with burning jade set atop the silks.

sentences.zh: 五人帝、五官白幣，日月、內官以下，幣從方色。

translations.literal: The Five Human Emperors and Five Officials: white silks; from Sun and Moon and inner officials downward, silks follow the color of the direction.
translations.idiomatic: For the Five Human Emperors and Five Officials: white silks; from the Sun and Moon and inner officials downward, silks followed the color of each direction.

sentences.zh: 九月二十四日未漏上水一刻，百官朝服，齋於文德殿。

translations.literal: On the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, one quarter before the upper water mark of the night watch, the hundred officials in court dress fasted at the Wende Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, one quarter before the upper water mark of the night watch, officials in court dress fasted at the Wende Hall.

sentences.zh: 明日未明二刻，鼓三嚴，帝服通天冠、降紗袍，玉輅，警蹕，赴景靈宮，即齋殿易袞圭，薦享天興殿畢，詣太廟宿齋，其禮具太廟。

translations.literal: The next day, two quarters before dawn, the three strictness drums sounded; the emperor wore the penetrating-heaven cap and descending gauze robe, took the jade carriage with imperial escort, proceeded to the Jingling Palace, changed to ceremonial robe and tablet in the fasting hall, completed the offering at the Tianxing Hall, then went to the Imperial Ancestral Temple to lodge in fasting—the rites are as in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: The next day, two quarters before dawn, the three strictness drums sounded; the emperor wore the penetrating-heaven cap and descending gauze robe, took the jade carriage with imperial escort to the Jingling Palace, changed to ceremonial robe and tablet in the fasting hall, completed the offering at the Tianxing Hall, then went to the Imperial Ancestral Temple to lodge in fasting—the rites followed those of the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 未明三刻，帝靴袍，小輦，殿門契勘，門下省奉寶輿先入。

translations.literal: Three quarters before dawn, the emperor in booted robe, small palanquin; hall gate tally inspected; the Secretariat presented the treasure carriage to enter first.
translations.idiomatic: Three quarters before dawn, the emperor wore his booted robe and took the small palanquin; the hall gate tally was inspected; the Secretariat presented the treasure carriage to enter first.

sentences.zh: 及大次，易袞圭入，至版位，樂舞作，沃盥，自大階升。

translations.literal: Reaching the great rest pavilion, he changed to ceremonial robe and tablet and entered, arrived at the position board, music and dance commenced, hands were washed, and he ascended by the great steps.
translations.idiomatic: At the great rest pavilion he changed to ceremonial robe and tablet and entered, reached the position board as music and dance commenced, washed his hands, and ascended by the great steps.

sentences.zh: 禮儀使導入太室，詣上帝位，奠玉幣於神坐，次皇地祇、五方帝、神州，次祖宗。

translations.literal: The ritual commissioner guided him into the Great Chamber, proceeded to the Supreme Lord's position, laid jade and silks at the spirit seat, next Imperial Earth Almighty, Five Directional Emperors, Divine Land, then the ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual commissioner guided him into the Great Chamber to the Supreme Lord's position, laid jade and silks at the spirit seat, then at Imperial Earth Almighty, the Five Directional Emperors, Divine Land, and finally the ancestors.

sentences.zh: 奠幣酌獻之敘亦然。

translations.literal: The sequence for laying silks and pouring offerings was likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The sequence for laying silks and pouring offerings followed the same order.

sentences.zh: 皇帝降自中階，還版位，樂止。

translations.literal: The emperor descended by the central steps, returned to the position board, and the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor descended by the central steps, returned to the position board, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 禮生引分獻官奉玉幣，祝史、齋郎助奠諸神坐，乃進熟。

translations.literal: Ritual students led the distributed offering officials bearing jade and silks; invokers and fasting officers assisted in laying offerings at the various spirit seats, then the cooked offerings were brought forward.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual students led the distributed offering officials bearing jade and silks; invokers and fasting officers assisted in laying offerings at the various spirit seats, then the cooked offerings were brought forward.

sentences.zh: 諸太祝迎上帝、皇地祇饌，升自中階；

translations.literal: The chief invokers received the offerings for Supreme Lord and Imperial Earth Almighty and ascended by the central steps;
translations.idiomatic: The chief invokers received the offerings for the Supreme Lord and Imperial Earth Almighty and ascended by the central steps;

sentences.zh: 青帝、赤帝、神州、配帝、大明、北極、太昊、神農氏饌，升自東階；

translations.literal: offerings for Green Emperor, Red Emperor, Divine Land, associate emperors, Great Brightness, North Pole, Great Hao, and Divine Farmer ascended by the east steps;
translations.idiomatic: offerings for the Green Emperor, Red Emperor, Divine Land, associate emperors, Great Brightness, North Pole, Great Hao, and Divine Farmer ascended by the east steps;

sentences.zh: 黃帝、白帝、黑帝、夜明、天皇大帝、軒轅、少昊、高陽氏饌，升自西階；

translations.literal: offerings for Yellow Emperor, White Emperor, Black Emperor, Night Brightness, August Heaven Great Emperor, Xuan Yuan, Lesser Hao, and Gaoyang ascended by the west steps;
translations.idiomatic: offerings for the Yellow Emperor, White Emperor, Black Emperor, Night Brightness, August Heaven Great Emperor, Xuan Yuan, Lesser Hao, and Gaoyang ascended by the west steps;

sentences.zh: 內中官、五官、外官、五星諸饌，隨便升設。

translations.literal: offerings for inner and middle officials, Five Officials, outer officials, and Five Stars were set as convenient.
translations.idiomatic: offerings for inner and middle officials, the Five Officials, outer officials, and the Five Stars were set wherever convenient.

sentences.zh: 亞獻將升，禮生分引獻官俱詣罍洗，各由其階酌獻五人帝、日月、天皇、北極，下及左右夾廡、丹墀、龍墀、庭中五官、東西廂外官眾星坐。

translations.literal: As the secondary offering was about to ascend, ritual students separately led offering officials all to the vessel washing, each by his steps pouring offerings to the Five Human Emperors, Sun and Moon, August Heaven, North Pole, and downward to the left and right side corridors, cinnabar terrace, dragon terrace, Five Officials in the courtyard, and outer officials and host of stars in the east and west wings.
translations.idiomatic: As the secondary offering was about to begin, ritual students led the offering officials separately to the vessel washing; each ascended by his assigned steps to pour offerings to the Five Human Emperors, Sun and Moon, August Heaven, North Pole, and then to positions in the left and right side corridors, cinnabar terrace, dragon terrace, Five Officials in the courtyard, and outer officials and host of stars in the east and west wings.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，帝還大次，解嚴，改服乘輦，禦紫宸殿，百官稱賀。

translations.literal: When the rites were complete, the emperor returned to the great rest pavilion, strictness was lifted, he changed clothes and took the palanquin, proceeded to the Zichen Hall, and the hundred officials offered congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites were complete, the emperor returned to the great rest pavilion, strictness was lifted, he changed clothes and took the palanquin to the Zichen Hall, where officials offered congratulations.

sentences.zh: 乃常服，禦宣德門肆赦，文武內外官遞進官有差。

translations.literal: Then in ordinary dress he proceeded to the Xuande Gate to proclaim amnesty; civil and military officials inside and outside were promoted in succession by rank.
translations.idiomatic: Then in ordinary dress he proceeded to the Xuande Gate to proclaim a general amnesty; civil and military officials inside and outside were promoted in succession according to rank.

sentences.zh: 宣制畢，宰臣百僚賀於樓下，賜百官福胙及內外致仕文武升朝官以上粟帛、羊酒。

translations.literal: When the proclamation was complete, the chief minister and hundred officials congratulated below the tower; he bestowed sacrificial meat upon the hundred officials and grain, silks, sheep, and wine upon retired civil and military officials of court rank and above, inside and outside.
translations.idiomatic: When the proclamation was complete, the chief minister and officials congratulated below the tower; he bestowed sacrificial meat upon officials and grain, silks, sheep, and wine upon retired civil and military officials of court rank and above, inside and outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐七年七月，詔復有事於明堂，有司言：「皇祐參用南郊百神之位，不應祭法。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of Jiayou 7, an edict restored the Bright Hall ceremony; the relevant offices said: "Huangyou drew on the Southern Suburb's positions for the hundred spirits—this does not accord with sacrificial law.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Jiayou 7 (1062), an edict restored the Bright Hall ceremony; the relevant offices reported: "The Huangyou rite drew on the Southern Suburb's positions for the hundred spirits, which does not accord with sacrificial law.

sentences.zh: 宜如隋、唐舊制，設昊天上帝、五方帝位，以真宗配，而五人帝、五官神從祀，餘皆罷。

translations.literal: It is appropriate to follow Sui and Tang old regulations, establishing positions for August Heaven Supreme Lord and the Five Directional Emperors, with Zhenzong as associate, while the Five Human Emperors and Five Official spirits follow in sacrifice—all else should be discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: It would be appropriate to follow the Sui and Tang regulations, establishing positions for August Heaven Supreme Lord and the Five Directional Emperors with Zhenzong as associate, while the Five Human Emperors and Five Official spirits follow in sacrifice—all else should be discontinued.

sentences.zh: 又前一日，親享太廟，嘗停孟冬之薦，考詳典禮，宗廟時祭，未有因嚴配而輟者。

translations.literal: Moreover, on the previous day personally enjoying the Imperial Ancestral Temple, the mid-winter offering had once been suspended; examining the canonical rites, seasonal sacrifices at the ancestral temple had never been discontinued because of a solemn associate sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, on the previous day the emperor was to offer personally at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; the mid-winter offering had once been suspended, but examining the canonical rites, seasonal sacrifices at the ancestral temple had never been discontinued because of a solemn associate sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 今明堂去孟冬畫日尚遠，請復薦廟。

translations.literal: Now the Bright Hall is still far from the mid-winter day mark—please restore the temple offering.
translations.idiomatic: As the Bright Hall ceremony is still far from the mid-winter day mark, we request that the temple offering be restored.

sentences.zh: 前者祖宗並侑，今用典禮獨配；

translations.literal: Previously the ancestors were all associates; now the canonical rites use a single associate;
translations.idiomatic: Previously all ancestors served as associates; now the canonical rites prescribe a single associate;

sentences.zh: 前者地祇、神州並享，今以配天而罷。

translations.literal: previously Earth Almighty and Divine Land were both enjoyed; now they are discontinued because of associating with Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: previously Earth Almighty and Divine Land were both sacrificed to; now they are discontinued in favor of associating with Heaven.

sentences.zh: 是皆變於禮中之大者也。

translations.literal: These are all major changes within the rites.
translations.idiomatic: These were all major changes within the ritual code.

sentences.zh: 《開元》、《開寶》二禮，五帝無親獻儀。

translations.literal: The Kaiyuan and Kaibao ritual codes have no personal offering procedure for the Five Emperors.
translations.idiomatic: The Kaiyuan and Kaibao ritual codes contain no procedure for the emperor's personal offering to the Five Emperors.

sentences.zh: 舊禮，先詣昊天奠獻，五帝並行分獻，以侍臣奠幣，皇帝再拜，次詣真宗神坐，於禮為允。」

translations.literal: Under the old rites, first proceed to August Heaven to lay the offering; the Five Emperors receive distributed offerings in parallel, with attendant ministers laying silks while the emperor bows twice, then proceed to Zhenzong's spirit seat—in ritual terms this is permissible."
translations.idiomatic: Under the old rites, the emperor first proceeded to August Heaven to lay the offering; the Five Emperors received distributed offerings in parallel, with attendant ministers laying silks while the emperor bowed twice, then proceeded to Zhenzong's spirit seat—this was ritually permissible."

sentences.zh: 而帝欲盡恭於祀事，五方帝位並親獻焉。

translations.literal: Yet the emperor wished to show full reverence in the sacrificial affair and personally offered at all Five Directional Emperor positions.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the emperor wished to show full reverence in the sacrifice and personally offered at all Five Directional Emperor positions.

sentences.zh: 朝廟用犢一，羊七，豕七；

translations.literal: For the temple audience: one calf, seven sheep, seven pigs;
translations.idiomatic: For the temple audience: one calf, seven sheep, and seven pigs;

sentences.zh: 昊天上帝、配帝犢各一，羊、豕各二；

translations.literal: August Heaven Supreme Lord and associate emperor: one calf each, two sheep and two pigs each;
translations.idiomatic: for August Heaven Supreme Lord and the associate emperor: one calf each, two sheep and two pigs each;

sentences.zh: 五方、五人帝共犢五，豕五，羊五；

translations.literal: Five Directions and Five Human Emperors together: five calves, five pigs, five sheep;
translations.idiomatic: for the Five Directions and Five Human Emperors together: five calves, five pigs, and five sheep;

sentences.zh: 五官從祀共羊、豕十。

translations.literal: Five Officials in attendant sacrifice together: ten sheep and ten pigs.
translations.idiomatic: for the Five Officials in attendant sacrifice: ten sheep and ten pigs in all.

sentences.zh: 英宗即位，禮官議仁宗配明堂，知制誥錢公輔等言：「《孝經》曰：'昔者周公郊祀後稷以配天，宗祀文王於明堂以配上帝。

translations.literal: When Emperor Yingzong took the throne, ritual officials deliberated on Renzong as associate at the Bright Hall; Drafting Edict Commissioner Qian Gongfu and others said: "The Classic of Filial Piety says: 'Formerly the Duke of Zhou performed suburban sacrifice to Hou Ji to associate with Heaven, and ancestral sacrifice to King Wen at the Bright Hall to associate with Supreme Lord.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Yingzong took the throne, ritual officials deliberated on associating Renzong at the Bright Hall; Drafting Edict Commissioner Qian Gongfu and others argued: "The Classic of Filial Piety states: 'Formerly the Duke of Zhou performed suburban sacrifice to Hou Ji to associate with Heaven, and ancestral sacrifice to King Wen at the Bright Hall to associate with the Supreme Lord.

sentences.zh: '又曰：'孝莫大于嚴父，嚴父莫大于配天，則周公其人也。

translations.literal: It also says: 'Of filial piety nothing is greater than honoring the father; of honoring the father nothing is greater than associating with Heaven—then the Duke of Zhou was such a man.
translations.idiomatic: It also states: 'Of filial piety nothing is greater than honoring the father; of honoring the father nothing is greater than associating with Heaven—the Duke of Zhou was such a man.

sentences.zh: '以周公言之則嚴父，以成王言之則嚴祖。

translations.literal: Speaking from the Duke of Zhou's perspective it is honoring the father; speaking from King Cheng's perspective it is honoring the ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: From the Duke of Zhou's perspective this is honoring the father; from King Cheng's perspective it is honoring the ancestor.

sentences.zh: 方是時，政則周公，祭則成王，亦安在必嚴其父哉？

translations.literal: At that time government was the Duke of Zhou's, sacrifice was King Cheng's—how could it be necessary to insist on honoring his father?
translations.idiomatic: At that time government was the Duke of Zhou's while sacrifice was King Cheng's—why must one insist on honoring his father?

sentences.zh: 《我將》之詩是也。

translations.literal: The ode "I Will" is the case in point.
translations.idiomatic: The ode "I Will" illustrates this point.

sentences.zh: 真宗則周之武王，仁宗則周之成王，雖有配天之業，而無配天之祭，未聞成、康以嚴父之故，廢文王配天之祭而移之。

translations.literal: Zhenzong corresponds to Zhou's King Wu, Renzong to Zhou's King Cheng—although they had the achievement of associating with Heaven, they had no sacrifice associating with Heaven; one has not heard that Cheng and Kang, because of honoring the father, abolished King Wen's sacrifice associating with Heaven and shifted it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenzong corresponds to King Wu of Zhou, Renzong to King Cheng—although they had the achievement of associating with Heaven, they had no sacrifice associating with Heaven; one never hears that Cheng and Kang, in the name of honoring the father, abolished King Wen's Heaven-associating sacrifice and transferred it elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 以孔子之心推周公之祭，則嚴父也；

translations.literal: Applying Confucius's mind to infer the Duke of Zhou's sacrifice, it is honoring the father;
translations.idiomatic: Applying Confucius's perspective to infer the Duke of Zhou's sacrifice, it is honoring the father;

sentences.zh: 以周公之心攝成王之祭，則嚴祖也，嚴祖、嚴父，其義一也。

translations.literal: applying the Duke of Zhou's mind to conduct King Cheng's sacrifice, it is honoring the ancestor—honoring the ancestor and honoring the father share one meaning.
translations.idiomatic: applying the Duke of Zhou's mind to conduct King Cheng's sacrifice, it is honoring the ancestor—honoring the ancestor and honoring the father share the same meaning.

sentences.zh: 漢明始建明堂，以光武配，當始配之代，適符嚴父之說，章、安二帝亦弗之變，最為近古而合乎禮。

translations.literal: Emperor Ming of Han first built the Bright Hall, with Guangwu as associate; at the generation of the first associate it happened to accord with the theory of honoring the father—Emperors Zhang and An also did not change it; this is closest to antiquity and accords with the rites.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ming of Han first built the Bright Hall with Guangwu as associate; at the generation of the first associate this happened to accord with the theory of honoring the father—Emperors Zhang and An also did not change it; this is closest to antiquity and accords with ritual propriety.

sentences.zh: 唐中宗時，則以高宗配；

translations.literal: Under Tang Zhongzong, Gaozong was the associate;
translations.idiomatic: Under Tang Zhongzong, Gaozong served as associate;

sentences.zh: 在玄宗時，則以睿宗配；

translations.literal: under Tang Xuanzong, Ruizong was the associate;
translations.idiomatic: under Tang Xuanzong, Ruizong served as associate;

sentences.zh: 在永泰時，則以肅宗配。

translations.literal: at Yongtai, Suzong was the associate.
translations.idiomatic: at Yongtai, Suzong served as associate.

sentences.zh: 禮官不能推明經訓，務合古初，反雷同其論以惑時主，延及於今，牢不可破。

translations.literal: Ritual officials could not extend and clarify the canonical teachings, striving to accord with ancient beginnings, but instead echoed one another's theories to mislead the ruler of the age—extending to today, firmly unbreakable.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual officials could not extend and clarify the canonical teachings or strive to accord with ancient beginnings, but instead echoed one another's theories to mislead successive rulers—a practice that extends to the present day and has become firmly entrenched.

sentences.zh: 仁宗嗣位之初，儻有建是論者，則配天之祭常在乎太宗矣。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Renzong's succession, if there had been one who advanced this theory, the sacrifice associating with Heaven would always have rested with Taizong.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Renzong's succession, if someone had advanced this theory, the Heaven-associating sacrifice would always have rested with Taizong.

sentences.zh: 願詔有司博議，使配天之祭不膠于嚴父，而嚴父之道不專乎配天。」

translations.literal: We wish an edict ordering the relevant offices to deliberate broadly, so that the sacrifice associating with Heaven is not bound to honoring the father, and the way of honoring the father is not confined to associating with Heaven."
translations.idiomatic: We request that Your Majesty order the relevant offices to deliberate broadly, so that the Heaven-associating sacrifice is not bound to honoring the father, and the way of honoring the father is not confined to associating with Heaven."

sentences.zh: 觀文殿學士孫抃等曰：「《易》稱'先王作樂崇德，薦之上帝，以配祖考'。

translations.literal: Academician of the Guanwen Hall Sun Bian and others said: "The Changes states: 'The former kings made music to exalt virtue, presented it to Supreme Lord, to associate with ancestors and fathers.
translations.idiomatic: Academician of the Guanwen Hall Sun Bian and others argued: "The Changes states: 'The former kings made music to exalt virtue and presented it to the Supreme Lord to associate with ancestors and fathers.

sentences.zh: 蓋祖、考並可配天，符於《孝經》之說，不可謂必嚴其父也。

translations.literal: For ancestors and fathers can both associate with Heaven, accordant with the Classic of Filial Piety's teaching—one cannot say it must honor his father.
translations.idiomatic: Ancestors and fathers can both associate with Heaven, which accords with the Classic of Filial Piety—one cannot say the rite must honor only one's father.

sentences.zh: 祖、考皆可配郊與明堂而不同位，不可謂嚴祖、嚴父其義一也。

translations.literal: Ancestors and fathers can both associate at suburban sacrifice and Bright Hall but in different positions—one cannot say honoring the ancestor and honoring the father share one meaning.
translations.idiomatic: Ancestors and fathers can both associate at suburban sacrifice and the Bright Hall but in different positions—one cannot say that honoring the ancestor and honoring the father share the same meaning.

sentences.zh: 雖周家不聞廢文配而移于武，廢武配而移于成，然《易》之配考，《孝經》之嚴父，歷代循守，不為無說。

translations.literal: Although in the Zhou house one does not hear of abolishing Wen's associate and shifting to Wu, or abolishing Wu's associate and shifting to Cheng, yet the Changes' associating with fathers and the Classic of Filial Piety's honoring the father have been followed through the ages—not without grounds.
translations.idiomatic: Although in the Zhou house one does not hear of abolishing Wen's associate and shifting to Wu, or abolishing Wu's associate and shifting to Cheng, the Changes' associating with fathers and the Classic of Filial Piety's honoring the father have been followed through the ages—not without justification.

sentences.zh: 魏明帝祀文帝於明堂以配上帝，史官謂是時二漢之制具存，則魏所損益可知，亦不可謂章、安之後配祭無傳，遂以為未嘗嚴父也。

translations.literal: Wei Emperor Ming sacrificed to Emperor Wen at the Bright Hall to associate with Supreme Lord; historians say that at that time the institutions of the two Han were fully preserved, so Wei additions and subtractions can be known—one also cannot say that after Zhang and An there is no transmission of associate sacrifice and therefore conclude they never honored the father.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Emperor Ming sacrificed to Emperor Wen at the Bright Hall to associate with the Supreme Lord; historians note that at that time the institutions of the two Han were fully preserved, so Wei's additions and subtractions are known—one also cannot say that after Zhang and An there is no record of associate sacrifice and therefore conclude they never honored the father.

sentences.zh: 唐至本朝講求不為少，所以不敢異者，舍周、孔之言無所本也。

translations.literal: From Tang to our dynasty inquiry has not been slight; the reason for not daring to differ is that apart from Zhou and Confucius's words there is no foundation.
translations.idiomatic: From Tang to our dynasty inquiry has not been slight; the reason for not daring to differ is that apart from the words of the Zhou and Confucius there is no foundation.

sentences.zh: 今以為《我將》之詩，祀文王於明堂而歌者，安知非孔子刪《詩》，存周全盛之《頌》被於管弦者，獨取之也？

translations.literal: Now to take the ode "I Will" as sacrificing to King Wen at the Bright Hall and singing it—how does one know it was not Confucius editing the Odes, preserving the Zhou hymns of full flourishing set to strings and pipes, and taking this one alone?
translations.idiomatic: To take the ode "I Will" as evidence of sacrificing to King Wen at the Bright Hall—how do we know this was not simply Confucius editing the Odes, preserving the Zhou hymns of the dynasty's full flourishing for performance, and selecting this one alone?

sentences.zh: 仁宗繼體守成，置天下於泰安四十二年，功德可謂極矣。

translations.literal: Renzong succeeded to the foundation and preserved the accomplishment, placing the realm in great peace for forty-two years—merit and virtue can be called utmost.
translations.idiomatic: Renzong succeeded to the foundation and preserved the accomplishment, keeping the realm in great peace for forty-two years—his merit and virtue can be called supreme.

sentences.zh: 今祔廟之始，抑而不得配帝，甚非所以宣章嚴父之大孝。」

translations.literal: Now at the beginning of enshrinement in the temple, he is suppressed and cannot associate with the Lord—this is very far from proclaiming and displaying the great filial piety of honoring the father."
translations.idiomatic: Now at the beginning of his enshrinement in the temple, he is denied association with the Lord—this falls far short of proclaiming the great filial piety of honoring the father."

sentences.zh: 諫官司馬光、呂誨曰：「孝子之心，孰不欲尊其父？

translations.literal: Remonstrance Bureau officials Sima Guang and Lu Hui said: "In a filial son's heart, who does not wish to honor his father?
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrance Bureau officials Sima Guang and Lu Hui argued: "In a filial son's heart, who does not wish to honor his father?

sentences.zh: 聖人制禮以為之極，不敢逾也。

translations.literal: The sage instituted the rites to set its limit—one dare not exceed it.
translations.idiomatic: The sage instituted the rites to set its limit, and one dare not exceed it.

sentences.zh: 《詩》曰：'思文後稷，克配彼天。

translations.literal: The Odes says: 'Reflecting on Wen, Hou Ji could associate with that Heaven.'
translations.idiomatic: The Odes states: 'Reflecting on Wen, Hou Ji could associate with that Heaven.'

sentences.zh: '又《我將》：'祀文王於明堂。

translations.literal: The ode "I Will" also says: 'Sacrificing to King Wen at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: The ode "I Will" also states: 'Sacrificing to King Wen at the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: '下此，皆不見於經。

translations.literal: Below these, none appear in the classics.
translations.idiomatic: Below these, none appear in the canonical classics.

sentences.zh: 前漢以高祖配天，後漢以光武配明堂。

translations.literal: Former Han used Gaozu to associate with Heaven; Later Han used Guangwu to associate at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Former Han associated Gaozu with Heaven; Later Han associated Guangwu at the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 以是觀之，自非建邦啟土、造有區夏者，皆無配天之文。

translations.literal: Viewed thus, unless one founded the state, opened the territory, and created the realm within the four seas, none has the text of associating with Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Viewed thus, unless one founded the state, opened its territory, and created the realm within the four seas, none has the authority to associate with Heaven.

sentences.zh: 故雖周之成、康，漢之文、景、明、章，德業非不美也，然而不敢推以配天，避祖宗也。

translations.literal: Therefore although Zhou's Cheng and Kang, Han's Wen, Jing, Ming, and Zhang had merit and accomplishment not lacking in beauty, yet they did not dare promote themselves to associate with Heaven, deferring to the ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore although Zhou's Cheng and Kang, and Han's Wen, Jing, Ming, and Zhang had merit and accomplishment of no small beauty, they did not dare promote themselves to associate with Heaven, deferring to their ancestors.

sentences.zh: 孔子以周公有聖人之德，成太平之業，制禮作樂，而文王適其父，故引以證'聖人之德莫大於孝'答曾子，非謂凡有天下者皆當尊其父以配天，然後為孝也。

translations.literal: Confucius, because the Duke of Zhou had a sage's virtue, accomplished the great peace, instituted rites and made music, and King Wen happened to be his father, therefore cited this to prove 'of a sage's virtue nothing is greater than filial piety' in answering Zengzi—not meaning that everyone who possesses the realm must honor his father to associate with Heaven before being filial.
translations.idiomatic: Confucius, because the Duke of Zhou possessed a sage's virtue, accomplished great peace, instituted rites and made music, and King Wen happened to be his father, cited this to prove that 'of a sage's virtue nothing is greater than filial piety' in answering Zengzi—not meaning that everyone who possesses the realm must honor his father to associate with Heaven in order to be filial.

sentences.zh: 近代祀明堂者，皆以其父配上帝，此乃誤釋《孝經》之義，而違先王之禮也。

translations.literal: In recent times those who sacrifice at the Bright Hall all use their father to associate with Supreme Lord—this mistakenly interprets the Classic of Filial Piety's meaning and violates the former kings' rites.
translations.idiomatic: In recent times those who sacrifice at the Bright Hall all use their father to associate with the Supreme Lord—this misinterprets the Classic of Filial Piety and violates the rites of the former kings.

sentences.zh: 景祐中，以太祖為帝者之祖，比周之後稷，太宗、真宗為帝者之宗，比周之文、武，然則祀真宗於明堂以配上帝，亦未失古禮。

translations.literal: In Jingyou, Taizu was taken as the founder-ancestor of emperors, comparable to Zhou's Hou Ji; Taizong and Zhenzong as the lineage-ancestors of emperors, comparable to Zhou's Wen and Wu—thus sacrificing to Zhenzong at the Bright Hall to associate with Supreme Lord also did not depart from ancient rites.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingyou, Taizu was taken as the founder-ancestor of emperors, comparable to Zhou's Hou Ji; Taizong and Zhenzong as lineage-ancestors, comparable to Zhou's Wen and Wu—thus sacrificing to Zhenzong at the Bright Hall to associate with the Supreme Lord did not depart from ancient ritual.

sentences.zh: 仁宗雖豐功美德洽于四海，而不在二祧之位，議者乃欲舍真宗而以仁宗配，恐於祭法不合。」

translations.literal: Although Renzong's great merit and virtue pervaded the four seas, he was not in the position of the two lineage-ancestors; deliberators wished to abandon Zhenzong and use Renzong as associate—this may not accord with sacrificial law."
translations.idiomatic: Although Renzong's great merit and virtue pervaded the four seas, he was not in the position of the two lineage-ancestors; deliberators wished to abandon Zhenzong and use Renzong as associate—this likely does not accord with sacrificial law."

sentences.zh: 詔從抃議。

translations.literal: An edict followed Bian's deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: An edict followed Bian's recommendation.

sentences.zh: 御史趙鼎請遞遷真宗配雩祭，太宗配祈穀、神州，用唐故事。

translations.literal: Censor Zhao Ding requested successive transfer of Zhenzong's associate at the rain-prayer sacrifice, Taizong at the grain-prayer and Divine Land sacrifices, following Tang precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Zhao Ding requested that Zhenzong's associate position at the rain-prayer sacrifice and Taizong's at the grain-prayer and Divine Land sacrifices be transferred in succession, following Tang precedent.

sentences.zh: 學士王珪等以為：「天地大祭有七，皆以始封受命創業之君配神作主，明堂用古嚴父之道配以近考，故在真宗時乙太宗配，在仁宗時以真宗配，今則以仁宗配。

translations.literal: Academician Wang Gui and others held: "The seven great sacrifices of Heaven and Earth all use the ruler who first received fief, mandate, and founded the enterprise to associate with the spirit as host; the Bright Hall uses the ancient way of honoring the father to associate with the recent father—thus under Zhenzong Taizong was associate, under Renzong Zhenzong, and now Renzong.
translations.idiomatic: Academician Wang Gui and others argued: "The seven great sacrifices of Heaven and Earth all use the ruler who first received fief, mandate, and founded the enterprise as the spirit's associate and host; the Bright Hall uses the ancient way of honoring the father to associate with the recent father—thus under Zhenzong Taizong was associate, under Renzong Zhenzong, and now Renzong should be associate.

sentences.zh: 仁宗始罷太宗明堂之配，太宗先已配雩祀、祈穀及神州之祭，本非遞遷。

translations.literal: Renzong first abolished Taizong's Bright Hall associate; Taizong had already been associate at rain-prayer, grain-prayer, and Divine Land sacrifices—this was not originally a successive transfer.
translations.idiomatic: Renzong first abolished Taizong's Bright Hall associate; Taizong had already been associate at the rain-prayer, grain-prayer, and Divine Land sacrifices—this was not originally a matter of successive transfer.

sentences.zh: 今明堂既用嚴父之道，則真宗配天之祭於禮當罷，不當復分雩祭之配也。」

translations.literal: Now that the Bright Hall uses the way of honoring the father, Zhenzong's Heaven-associating sacrifice should be discontinued in ritual terms—one should not again divide the rain-prayer associate."
translations.idiomatic: Now that the Bright Hall uses the way of honoring the father, Zhenzong's Heaven-associating sacrifice should be discontinued in ritual terms—one should not again divide the rain-prayer associate."

sentences.zh: 治平四年九月，大享明堂，以英宗配。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of Zhiping 4, the grand offering was performed at the Bright Hall, with Yingzong as associate.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Zhiping 4 (1067), the grand offering was performed at the Bright Hall, with Yingzong as associate.

sentences.zh: 元豐，詳定禮文所言：「祀帝南郊，以天道事之，則雖配帝用犢，《禮》所謂'帝牛不吉，以為稷牛'是也。

translations.literal: In Yuanfeng, the deliberation on ritual texts stated: "Sacrificing to the Lord at the Southern Suburb, serving him by the Way of Heaven—even for the associate emperor a calf is used; this is what the Rites means by 'the Lord's ox is inauspicious—use the Hou Ji ox.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanfeng, the deliberation on ritual texts stated: "Sacrificing to the Lord at the Southern Suburb, serving him by the Way of Heaven—even for the associate emperor a calf is used; this is what the Rites means by 'the Lord's ox is inauspicious—use the Hou Ji ox instead.

sentences.zh: 享帝明堂，以人道事之，則雖天帝用太牢，《詩》所謂'我將我享，維羊維牛'是也。

translations.literal: Enjoying the Lord at the Bright Hall, serving him by the Way of Humanity—even for the Heavenly Lord the great offering is used; this is what the Odes means by 'I will, I will enjoy—both sheep and oxen.'
translations.idiomatic: Enjoying the Lord at the Bright Hall, serving him by the Way of Humanity—even for the Heavenly Lord the great offering is used; this is what the Odes means by 'I will, I will enjoy—both sheep and oxen.'

sentences.zh: 自梁用特牛，隋、唐因之，皆用特牲，非所謂以人道享上帝之意也。

translations.literal: Since Liang used a special ox, Sui and Tang followed—all used special victims; this is not what is meant by enjoying Supreme Lord by the Way of Humanity.
translations.idiomatic: Since Liang used a special ox and Sui and Tang followed, all used special victims—this is not what is meant by enjoying the Supreme Lord by the Way of Humanity.

sentences.zh: 皇祐、熙寧所用犢與羊、豕，皆未應禮。

translations.literal: The calves, sheep, and pigs used in Huangyou and Xining all did not accord with the rites.
translations.idiomatic: The calves, sheep, and pigs used in Huangyou and Xining all failed to accord with the rites.

sentences.zh: 今親祠上帝、配帝、五方帝、五人帝，請用牛、羊、豕各一。」

translations.literal: Now for personal sacrifice to Supreme Lord, associate emperor, Five Directional Emperors, and Five Human Emperors, we request one each of ox, sheep, and pig."
translations.idiomatic: For personal sacrifice to the Supreme Lord, associate emperor, Five Directional Emperors, and Five Human Emperors, we request one each of ox, sheep, and pig."

sentences.zh: 太常禮院言：「今歲明堂，尚在慈聖光獻皇后三年之內，請如熙甯元年南郊故事，惟祀事用樂，鹵簿鼓吹、宮架、諸軍音樂皆備而不作，警場止鳴金鉦、鼓角而已。」

translations.literal: The Directorate of Ritual Affairs of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices said: "This year's Bright Hall is still within the three-year mourning for Empress Dowager Cisheng Guangxian; we request following the Xining 1 Southern Suburb precedent—only the sacrificial affair uses music; guard of honor, wind and percussion, palace frame, and all military music are prepared but not performed; the alert ground sounds only metal gongs and horns."
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Ritual Affairs said: "This year's Bright Hall falls still within the three-year mourning for Empress Dowager Cisheng Guangxian; we request following the Xining 1 Southern Suburb precedent—only the sacrificial affair uses music; the guard of honor, wind and percussion, palace frame, and all military music are prepared but not performed; the alert ground sounds only metal gongs and horns."

sentences.zh: 自是，凡國有故皆用此制。

translations.literal: From this onward, whenever the state had occasion for mourning, this regulation was used.
translations.idiomatic: From this onward, whenever the state was in mourning, this regulation was applied.

sentences.zh: 六月，詔曰：「歷代以來，合宮所配，雜以先儒六天之說，朕甚不取。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, an edict said: "Through the ages, the associates at the Bright Hall have been mixed with the former scholars' theory of the Six Heavens—we do not accept this.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, an edict stated: "Through the ages, Bright Hall associates have been mixed with the former scholars' theory of the Six Heavens—we do not accept this.

sentences.zh: 將來祀英宗皇帝于明堂，惟以配上帝，餘從祀群神悉罷。」

translations.literal: In the future, when sacrificing to Emperor Yingzong at the Bright Hall, he alone shall associate with Supreme Lord—all other attendant spirits are discontinued."
translations.idiomatic: When we sacrifice to Emperor Yingzong at the Bright Hall, he alone shall associate with the Supreme Lord—all other attendant spirits are discontinued."

sentences.zh: 詳定所言：「按《周禮》有稱昊天上帝，有稱上帝，有稱五帝者，一帝而已。

translations.literal: The deliberators stated: "According to the Zhou Rites, there is mention of August Heaven Supreme Lord, mention of Supreme Lord, and mention of the Five Emperors—yet there is only one Lord.
translations.idiomatic: The deliberators stated: "According to the Zhou Rites, there is mention of August Heaven Supreme Lord, of Supreme Lord, and of the Five Emperors—yet there is only one Lord.

sentences.zh: 將來祀英宗於明堂，合配昊天上帝及五帝，欲以此修入儀注。」

translations.literal: In the future sacrifice to Yingzong at the Bright Hall, jointly associating August Heaven Supreme Lord and the Five Emperors—we wish to revise this into the ritual regulations."
translations.idiomatic: For the future sacrifice to Yingzong at the Bright Hall, jointly associating August Heaven Supreme Lord and the Five Emperors—we wish to revise this into the ritual regulations."

sentences.zh: 並據知太常禮院趙君錫等狀：「按《周官》掌次職曰：'王大旅上帝，則張氈案；

translations.literal: Also citing the memorial of Director of Ritual Affairs Zhao Junxi and others: "According to the Zhou Offices, the office of managing rest pavilions states: 'When the king performs the great journey to Supreme Lord, spread felt mats;
translations.idiomatic: Also citing the memorial of Director of Ritual Affairs Zhao Junxi and others: "According to the Zhou Offices, the office managing rest pavilions states: 'When the king performs the great journey to the Supreme Lord, spread felt mats;

sentences.zh: 祀五帝，則設大次、小次。

translations.literal: when sacrificing to the Five Emperors, set up great and small rest pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: when sacrificing to the Five Emperors, set up great and small rest pavilions.

sentences.zh: '又司服職曰：'祀昊天上帝則服大裘而冕，祀五帝亦如之。

translations.literal: The office of managing garments also states: 'When sacrificing to August Heaven Supreme Lord, wear the great fur robe and cap; when sacrificing to the Five Emperors, likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The office of managing garments also states: 'When sacrificing to August Heaven Supreme Lord, wear the great fur robe and cap; when sacrificing to the Five Emperors, likewise.

sentences.zh: '明上帝與五帝異。

translations.literal: This shows Supreme Lord and the Five Emperors are distinct.
translations.idiomatic: This shows the Supreme Lord and the Five Emperors are distinct.

sentences.zh: 則宗祀文王以配上帝者，非可兼五帝也。

translations.literal: Thus ancestral sacrifice to King Wen to associate with Supreme Lord cannot also include the Five Emperors.
translations.idiomatic: Thus ancestral sacrifice to King Wen to associate with the Supreme Lord cannot also include the Five Emperors.

sentences.zh: 自鄭氏之學興，乃有六天之說，而事非經見。

translations.literal: Since Master Zheng's learning arose, there came the theory of the Six Heavens—yet the matter is not seen in the classics.
translations.idiomatic: Since Master Zheng's learning arose, the theory of the Six Heavens appeared—yet the matter is not found in the classics.

sentences.zh: 晉泰始初，論者始以為非，遂於明堂惟設昊天上帝一坐而已。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jin Taishi, deliberators first held it incorrect, and at the Bright Hall only one seat for August Heaven Supreme Lord was established.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Jin Taishi, deliberators first held it incorrect, and at the Bright Hall only one seat for August Heaven Supreme Lord was established.

sentences.zh: 唐《顯慶禮》亦然。

translations.literal: Tang's Xianqing Rites likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Tang's Xianqing Rites followed the same practice.

sentences.zh: 請如詔祀英宗於明堂，惟配上帝，以稱嚴父之意。」

translations.literal: We request following the edict to sacrifice to Yingzong at the Bright Hall, associating only with Supreme Lord, to express the meaning of honoring the father."
translations.idiomatic: We request following the edict to sacrifice to Yingzong at the Bright Hall, associating only with the Supreme Lord, to express the meaning of honoring the father."

sentences.zh: 又請：「以莞席代稿秸、蒲越，以玉爵代匏爵，其豆、登、簋、俎、尊、罍並用宗廟之器，第以不稞，不用彝瓚。

translations.literal: They also requested: "Use cattail mats in place of straw and rush mats; use jade goblets in place of gourd goblets; platters, stands, grain vessels, meat trays, wine vessels, and jars all use ancestral temple vessels—only without grain libation, not using yi and guan vessels.
translations.idiomatic: They also requested: "Use cattail mats in place of straw and rush mats; use jade goblets in place of gourd goblets; platters, stands, grain vessels, meat trays, wine vessels, and jars all use ancestral temple vessels—only without grain libation, not using yi and guan vessels.

sentences.zh: 罷爟火及設褥，上帝席以稿秸，配帝席以蒲越，皆加褥其上。

translations.literal: Discontinue signal fires and setting cushions; Supreme Lord's seat uses straw, associate emperor's seat uses rush, both with cushions added atop.
translations.idiomatic: Discontinue signal fires and setting cushions; the Supreme Lord's seat uses straw, the associate emperor's seat uses rush, both with cushions added atop.

sentences.zh: 飲福受胙，俟終三獻。」

translations.literal: Drinking the blessing and receiving sacrificial meat—wait until the three offerings are complete."
translations.idiomatic: Drinking the blessing and receiving sacrificial meat should wait until the three offerings are complete."

sentences.zh: 並從之。

translations.literal: All were followed.
translations.idiomatic: All were approved.

sentences.zh: 監察御史裏行王祖道言：「前詔以六天之說為非古，今復欲兼祀五帝，是亦六天也。

translations.literal: Investigating Censor-in-Training Wang Zudao said: "The previous edict held the Six Heavens theory unancient; now you again wish to sacrifice jointly to the Five Emperors—this is also the Six Heavens.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating Censor-in-Training Wang Zudao argued: "The previous edict held the Six Heavens theory unancient; now you again wish to sacrifice jointly to the Five Emperors—this is also the Six Heavens.

sentences.zh: 禮官欲去四圭而廢祀神之玉，殊失事天之禮。

translations.literal: Ritual officials wish to remove the four gui and abolish the jade for sacrificing to spirits—this greatly departs from the rite of serving Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual officials wish to remove the four gui and abolish the jade for sacrificing to spirits—this greatly departs from the rite of serving Heaven.

sentences.zh: 望復舉前詔，以正萬世之失。」

translations.literal: We hope you will again uphold the previous edict to correct the error for ten thousand generations."
translations.idiomatic: We hope Your Majesty will again uphold the previous edict to correct the error for ten thousand generations."

sentences.zh: 仍並詔詳定合用圭、璧。

translations.literal: An edict still ordered the deliberators to determine which gui and bi disks should be used.
translations.idiomatic: An edict still ordered the deliberators to determine which gui and bi disks should be used.

sentences.zh: 詳定所言：「宋朝祀天禮以蒼璧，則燎玉亦用蒼璧；

translations.literal: The deliberators stated: "Song's rite of sacrificing to Heaven uses the green bi disk—then burning jade also uses the green bi;
translations.idiomatic: The deliberators stated: "Song's rite of sacrificing to Heaven uses the green bi disk—then burning jade also uses the green bi;

sentences.zh: 禮神以四圭有邸，則燎玉亦用四圭有邸。

translations.literal: honoring spirits with four gui with pedestals—then burning jade also uses four gui with pedestals.
translations.idiomatic: honoring spirits with four gui with pedestals—then burning jade also uses four gui with pedestals.

sentences.zh: 而議者欲以蒼璧禮神，以四圭有邸從燎，義無所主。

translations.literal: Yet deliberators wish to use the green bi to honor spirits and the four gui with pedestals for burning—the meaning has no foundation.
translations.idiomatic: Yet deliberators wish to use the green bi to honor spirits and the four gui with pedestals for burning—the meaning has no foundation.

sentences.zh: 《開寶》、《開元禮》，祀昊天上帝及五帝於明堂，禮神燔燎皆用四圭有邸。

translations.literal: The Kaibao and Kaiyuan Rites: sacrificing to August Heaven Supreme Lord and the Five Emperors at the Bright Hall—honoring spirits and burning all use four gui with pedestals.
translations.idiomatic: The Kaibao and Kaiyuan Rites: sacrificing to August Heaven Supreme Lord and the Five Emperors at the Bright Hall—honoring spirits and burning all use four gui with pedestals.

sentences.zh: 今詔唯祀上帝，則四圭有邸，自不當設。

translations.literal: Now the edict sacrifices only to Supreme Lord—then four gui with pedestals naturally should not be set.
translations.idiomatic: Now the edict sacrifices only to the Supreme Lord—then four gui with pedestals naturally should not be set.

sentences.zh: 宜如南郊，禮神燔燎皆用蒼璧。」

translations.literal: It is appropriate to follow the Southern Suburb—honoring spirits and burning all use the green bi."
translations.idiomatic: It is appropriate to follow the Southern Suburb—honoring spirits and burning all use the green bi."

sentences.zh: 又請：「宿齋於文德殿，祭之旦，服通天冠、絳紗袍，至大次，改祭服行事，如郊廟之禮。」

translations.literal: They also requested: "Lodge in fasting at the Wende Hall; on the morning of sacrifice, wear the penetrating-heaven cap and crimson gauze robe; at the great rest pavilion, change to sacrificial dress to perform the rite, as at suburban sacrifice and temple."
translations.idiomatic: They also requested: "Lodge in fasting at the Wende Hall; on the morning of sacrifice, wear the penetrating-heaven cap and crimson gauze robe; at the great rest pavilion, change to sacrificial dress to perform the rite, as at suburban sacrifice and temple."

sentences.zh: 政和五年，詔：「宗祀明堂以配上帝，寓於寢殿，禮蓋雲闕。

translations.literal: In Zhenghe 5, an edict said: "Ancestral sacrifice at the Bright Hall to associate with Supreme Lord has been lodged in the sleeping hall—the rite is like clouds parting.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenghe 5 (1115), an edict stated: "Ancestral sacrifice at the Bright Hall to associate with the Supreme Lord has been lodged in the sleeping hall—the rite has become like clouds parting.

sentences.zh: 崇甯之初，嘗詔建立，去古既遠，歷代之模無足循襲。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chongning, an edict once ordered establishment, but distant from antiquity, models of successive ages are insufficient to follow.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Chongning, an edict once ordered its establishment, but distant from antiquity, models of successive ages are insufficient to follow.

sentences.zh: 朕刺經稽古，度以九筵，分其五室，通以八風，上圓下方，參合先王之制。

translations.literal: We have probed the classics and examined antiquity, measuring by nine mats, dividing five chambers, connecting eight winds, round above and square below—combining the former kings' regulations.
translations.idiomatic: We have probed the classics and examined antiquity, measuring by nine mats, dividing five chambers, connecting eight winds, round above and square below—combining the regulations of the former kings.

sentences.zh: 相方視址，于寢之南，僝工鳩材，自我作古，以稱朕昭事上帝率見昭考之心。」

translations.literal: We examined the directions and viewed the site south of the sleeping quarters, gathered craftsmen and assembled materials, making antiquity anew ourselves, to express our mind of clearly serving Supreme Lord and leading forth the bright father."
translations.idiomatic: We examined the directions and viewed the site south of the sleeping quarters, gathered craftsmen and assembled materials, making antiquity anew ourselves, to express our mind of clearly serving the Supreme Lord and leading forth the bright father."

sentences.zh: 既又以言者「明堂基宜正臨丙方近東，以據福德之地」，乃徙秘書省宣德門東，以其地為明堂。

translations.literal: Then because speakers said "the Bright Hall foundation should directly face the bing direction near the east, to occupy the land of fortune and virtue," the Secretariat was moved east of the Xuande Gate and that site made the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Then because advisers said "the Bright Hall foundation should directly face the bing direction near the east, to occupy the land of fortune and virtue," the Secretariat was moved east of the Xuande Gate and that site was made the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 又詔：「明堂之制，朕取《考工》互見之文，得其製作之本。

translations.literal: Another edict said: "For the Bright Hall's regulations, we take the mutually illuminating texts of the Artificers' Record and obtain the root of its construction.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict stated: "For the Bright Hall's regulations, we take the mutually illuminating texts of the Artificers' Record and obtain the root of its construction.

sentences.zh: 夏後氏曰世室，堂修二七，廣四修一，五室三四步四三尺，九階，四旁兩夾窗。

translations.literal: The Xia house called it the Generational Chamber: hall length two-seven, width four-one, five chambers three-four paces four-three feet, nine steps, four sides with windows flanking both sides.
translations.idiomatic: The Xia house called it the Generational Chamber: hall length two-seven, width four-one, five chambers three-four paces four-three feet, nine steps, four sides with windows flanking both sides.

sentences.zh: 考夏後氏之制，名曰世室，又曰堂者，則世室非廟堂。

translations.literal: Examining the Xia house's regulations, called the Generational Chamber and also called a hall—thus the Generational Chamber is not the temple hall.
translations.idiomatic: Examining the Xia house's regulations, called the Generational Chamber and also called a hall—thus the Generational Chamber is not the temple hall.

sentences.zh: 修二七，廣四修一，則度以六尺之步，其堂修十四步，廣十七步之半。

translations.literal: Length two-seven, width four-one—then measured by the six-foot pace, the hall is fourteen paces long and seventeen and a half paces wide.
translations.idiomatic: Length two-seven, width four-one—then measured by the six-foot pace, the hall is fourteen paces long and seventeen and a half paces wide.

sentences.zh: 又曰五室三四步四三尺者，四步益四尺，中央土室也，三步益三尺，木、火、金、水四室也。

translations.literal: It also says five chambers of three-four paces four-three feet: four paces plus four feet is the central earth chamber; three paces plus three feet are the wood, fire, metal, and water four chambers.
translations.idiomatic: It also says five chambers of three-four paces four-three feet: four paces plus four feet is the central earth chamber; three paces plus three feet are the wood, fire, metal, and water four chambers.

sentences.zh: 每室四戶，戶兩夾窗，此夏制也。

translations.literal: Each chamber has four doors, each door flanked by windows—this is Xia regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Each chamber has four doors, each door flanked by windows—this is Xia regulation.

sentences.zh: 商人重屋，堂修七尋，崇三尺，四阿重屋，而又曰堂者，非寢也。

translations.literal: The Shang people had the Layered House: hall length seven xun, height three chi, four-eaved layered house—and also called a hall, not a sleeping quarters.
translations.idiomatic: The Shang people had the Layered House: hall length seven xun, height three chi, four-eaved layered house—and also called a hall, not sleeping quarters.

sentences.zh: 度以八尺之尋，其堂修七尋。

translations.literal: Measured by the eight-foot xun, its hall is seven xun long.
translations.idiomatic: Measured by the eight-foot xun, its hall is seven xun long.

sentences.zh: 又曰四阿重屋，阿者屋之曲也，重者屋之復也，則商人有四隅之阿，四柱復屋，則知下方也。

translations.literal: It also says four-eaved layered house: eaves are the house's curves, layers are the house's doubling—thus the Shang had eaves at the four corners and four pillars with doubled roof, so we know it was square below.
translations.idiomatic: It also says four-eaved layered house: eaves are the house's curves, layers are the house's doubling—thus the Shang had eaves at the four corners and four pillars with doubled roof, so we know it was square below.

sentences.zh: 周人明堂度以九尺之筵。

translations.literal: The Zhou people's Bright Hall was measured by the nine-foot mat.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhou people's Bright Hall was measured by the nine-foot mat.

sentences.zh: 三代之制不相襲，夏曰世室，商曰重屋，周曰明堂，則知皆室也。

translations.literal: The three dynasties' regulations do not follow one another: Xia called it Generational Chamber, Shang Layered House, Zhou Bright Hall—thus we know all are chambers.
translations.idiomatic: The three dynasties' regulations do not follow one another: Xia called it Generational Chamber, Shang Layered House, Zhou Bright Hall—thus we know all are chambers.

sentences.zh: 東西九筵，南北七筵，堂崇一筵，五室，凡室二筵者，九筵則東西長，七筵則南北狹，所以象天，則知上圜也。

translations.literal: East-west nine mats, north-south seven mats, hall height one mat, five chambers—wherever chambers are two mats, nine mats means long east-west, seven mats means narrow north-south—thus symbolizing Heaven, so we know round above.
translations.idiomatic: East-west nine mats, north-south seven mats, hall height one mat, five chambers—wherever chambers are two mats, nine mats means long east-west, seven mats means narrow north-south—thus symbolizing Heaven, so we know it was round above.

sentences.zh: 名不相襲，其制則一，唯步、尋、筵廣狹不同而已。

translations.literal: Names do not follow one another, yet the regulation is one—only pace, xun, and mat differ in breadth and narrowness.
translations.idiomatic: Names do not follow one another, yet the regulation is one—only pace, xun, and mat differ in breadth and narrowness.

sentences.zh: 朕益世室之度，兼四阿重屋之制，度以九尺之筵，上圜象天，下方法地，四戶以合四序，八窗以應八節，五室以象五行，十二堂以聽十二朔。

translations.literal: We increase the Generational Chamber's dimensions, combine the four-eaved layered house's regulation, measure by the nine-foot mat, round above symbolizing Heaven, square below symbolizing Earth, four doors to accord with four seasons, eight windows to respond to eight nodes, five chambers to symbolize five phases, twelve halls to hear twelve new moons.
translations.idiomatic: We increase the Generational Chamber's dimensions, combine the four-eaved layered house's regulation, measure by the nine-foot mat, round above symbolizing Heaven, square below symbolizing Earth, four doors to accord with four seasons, eight windows to respond to eight nodes, five chambers to symbolize five phases, twelve halls to hear twelve new moons.

sentences.zh: 九階、四阿，每室四戶，夾以八窗。

translations.literal: Nine steps, four eaves, each chamber four doors flanked by eight windows.
translations.idiomatic: Nine steps, four eaves, each chamber with four doors flanked by eight windows.

sentences.zh: 享帝嚴父，聽朔布政於一堂之上，于古皆合，其制大備。

translations.literal: Enjoying the Lord and honoring the father, hearing the new moon and promulgating government upon one hall—all accord with antiquity; its regulation is fully complete.
translations.idiomatic: Enjoying the Lord and honoring the father, hearing the new moon and promulgating government upon one hall—all accord with antiquity; its regulation is fully complete.

sentences.zh: 宜令明堂使司遵圖建立。」

translations.literal: The Bright Hall commissioner should be ordered to follow the diagram and establish it."
translations.idiomatic: The Bright Hall commissioner should be ordered to follow the diagram and establish it."

sentences.zh: 於是內出圖式，宣示於崇政殿，命蔡京為明堂使，開局興工，日役萬人。

translations.literal: Thereupon diagrams were issued from within, displayed at the Chongzheng Hall, Cai Jing appointed Bright Hall commissioner, an office opened and construction begun, ten thousand men laboring daily.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon diagrams were issued from within and displayed at the Chongzheng Hall; Cai Jing was appointed Bright Hall commissioner, an office opened and construction begun, with ten thousand men laboring daily.

sentences.zh: 京言：「三代之制，修廣不相襲，夏度以六尺之步，商度以八尺之尋，而周以九尺之筵，世每近，制每廣。

translations.literal: Jing said: "The three dynasties' regulations—length and breadth do not follow one another; Xia measured by the six-foot pace, Shang by the eight-foot xun, Zhou by the nine-foot mat; each age nearer, each regulation broader.
translations.idiomatic: Jing said: "The three dynasties' regulations—length and breadth do not follow one another; Xia measured by the six-foot pace, Shang by the eight-foot xun, Zhou by the nine-foot mat; each age nearer to our own, each regulation broader.

sentences.zh: 今若以二筵為太室，方一丈八尺，則室中設版位、禮器已不可容，理當增廣。

translations.literal: Now if the Great Chamber uses two mats, square one zhang eight chi, then setting spirit tablets and ritual vessels within the chamber already cannot be contained—reasonably it should be increased.
translations.idiomatic: Now if the Great Chamber uses two mats, square one zhang eight chi, then setting spirit tablets and ritual vessels within the chamber already cannot be accommodated—reasonably it should be enlarged.

sentences.zh: 今從周制，以九尺之筵為度，太室修四筵，三丈六尺。

translations.literal: Now following Zhou regulation, using the nine-foot mat as measure, the Great Chamber length four mats, three zhang six chi.
translations.idiomatic: Now following Zhou regulation, using the nine-foot mat as measure, the Great Chamber is four mats long, three zhang six chi.

sentences.zh: 廣五筵，四丈五尺。

translations.literal: Width five mats, four zhang five chi.
translations.idiomatic: Width five mats, four zhang five chi.

sentences.zh: 共為九筵。

translations.literal: Together making nine mats.
translations.idiomatic: Together making nine mats.

sentences.zh: 木、火、金、水四室各修三筵，益四五，三丈一尺五寸。

translations.literal: Wood, fire, metal, and water four chambers each length three mats plus four-five, three zhang one chi five cun.
translations.idiomatic: Wood, fire, metal, and water four chambers each three mats plus four-five, three zhang one chi five cun in length.

sentences.zh: 廣四筵，三丈六尺。

translations.literal: Width four mats, three zhang six chi.
translations.idiomatic: Width four mats, three zhang six chi.

translations.literal: The twelve halls in antiquity had no length and breadth numbers—now they too are broadened by the nine-foot mat.
translations.idiomatic: The twelve halls in antiquity had no length and breadth numbers—now they too are broadened by the nine-foot mat.

translations.idiomatic: Bright Hall and Dark Hall each four mats long, three zhang six chi.
