sentences.zh: 蔡攸言：「明堂五門，諸廊結瓦，古無制度，漢、唐或蓋以茅，或蓋以瓦，或以木為瓦，以夾紵漆之。

translations.literal: Cai You said: "The Bright Hall's five gates and all corridors with tiled roofs—in antiquity there was no regulation; Han and Tang sometimes covered with thatch, sometimes with tiles, sometimes made tiles of wood lacquered with ramie cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Cai You said: "The Bright Hall's five gates and all corridors with tiled roofs—in antiquity there was no regulation; Han and Tang sometimes covered with thatch, sometimes with tiles, sometimes made tiles of wood lacquered with ramie cloth.

sentences.zh: 今酌古之制，適今之宜，蓋以素瓦，而用琉璃緣裏及頂蓋鴟尾綴飾，上施銅雲龍。

translations.literal: Now weighing ancient regulations and suiting present appropriateness, cover with plain tiles, using glazed tiles for edging and lining and roof peak owl-tail ornaments, atop set bronze cloud-dragons.
translations.idiomatic: Now weighing ancient regulations and suiting present needs, cover with plain tiles, using glazed tiles for edging and lining and roof peak owl-tail ornaments, with bronze cloud-dragons set atop.

sentences.zh: 其地則隨所向甃以五色之石。

translations.literal: The ground according to each direction is paved with stones of the five colors.
translations.idiomatic: The ground according to each direction is paved with stones of the five colors.

sentences.zh: 欄楯柱端以銅為文鹿或辟邪象。

translations.literal: Railing posts and column ends use bronze for patterned deer or ward-off-evil images.
translations.idiomatic: Railing posts and column ends use bronze for patterned deer or ward-off-evil images.

sentences.zh: 明堂設飾，雜以五色，而各以其方所尚之色。

translations.literal: The Bright Hall's furnishings mix the five colors, each using the color honored in its direction.
translations.idiomatic: The Bright Hall's furnishings mix the five colors, each using the color honored in its direction.

sentences.zh: 八窗、八柱則以青、黃、綠相間。

translations.literal: The eight windows and eight pillars then used blue-green, yellow, and green alternating.
translations.idiomatic: The eight windows and eight pillars alternated blue-green, yellow, and green.

sentences.zh: 堂室柱門欄楯，並塗以朱。

translations.literal: Hall chambers, pillars, gates, railings, and balustrades were all painted vermilion.
translations.idiomatic: The hall chambers, pillars, gates, railings, and balustrades were all painted vermilion.

sentences.zh: 堂階為三級，級崇三尺，共為一筵。

translations.literal: The hall steps were three grades; each grade was three chi high, together making one mat.
translations.idiomatic: The hall steps rose in three tiers, each three chi high, together equal to one mat.

sentences.zh: 庭樹松、梓、檜，門不設戟，殿角皆垂鈴。」

translations.literal: The courtyard was planted with pine, catalpa, and cypress; halberds were not set at the gates; all hall corners hung bells."
translations.idiomatic: The courtyard was planted with pine, catalpa, and cypress; halberds were not placed at the gates; and bells hung from every corner of the hall."

sentences.zh: 詔以「玄堂」犯祖諱，取「平在朔易」之義，改為平朔，門亦如之。

translations.literal: An edict said that "Dark Hall" violated an ancestral taboo; taking the meaning of "establishing order at the new moon's change," it was changed to Level New Moon, and the gate likewise.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated that "Dark Hall" violated an ancestral taboo; taking the meaning of "establishing order at the new moon's change," the name was changed to Level New Moon, and the gate was renamed accordingly.

sentences.zh: 仍改敷祐門曰左敷佑，左承天門曰右敷佑，右承天門曰平秩，更衣大次曰齋明殿。

translations.literal: Further, Broad Blessings Gate was changed to Left Broad Blessing, Left Receive Heaven Gate to Right Broad Blessing, Right Receive Heaven Gate to Level Order, and the great rest pavilion for changing robes to Fast-Clarity Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Broad Blessings Gate was renamed Left Broad Blessing; Left Receive Heaven Gate became Right Broad Blessing; Right Receive Heaven Gate became Level Order; and the great rest pavilion for changing robes was renamed Fast-Clarity Hall.

sentences.zh: 七年四月，明堂成，有司請頒常視朔聽朝。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of year 7, the Bright Hall was completed; the relevant offices requested the regular practice of viewing the new moon and holding court.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the seventh year, the Bright Hall was completed; the relevant offices requested that the regular practice of viewing the new moon and holding court be restored.

sentences.zh: 詔：「明堂專以配帝嚴父，余悉移於大慶、文德殿。」

translations.literal: An edict said: "The Bright Hall is exclusively for associating with the Lord to honor the father; all other functions shall be transferred to the Great Felicity and Wende halls."
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "The Bright Hall shall be used exclusively for associating with the Supreme Lord to honor the father; all other functions shall be transferred to the Great Felicity and Wende halls."

sentences.zh: 群臣五表陳請，乃從之。

translations.literal: The ministers five times submitted memorials requesting this; then he assented.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers submitted five memorials requesting this, and the emperor finally assented.

sentences.zh: 禮制局言：「祀天神於冬至，祀地祇於夏至，乃有常日，無所事卜。

translations.literal: The Ritual Regulations Bureau said: "Sacrificing to heavenly spirits at the winter solstice and to earthly spirits at the summer solstice have fixed days, with no need for divination.
translations.idiomatic: The Ritual Regulations Bureau reported: "Sacrifices to heavenly spirits at the winter solstice and to earthly spirits at the summer solstice have fixed days and require no divination.

sentences.zh: 季秋享帝，以先王配，則有常月而未有常日。

translations.literal: The autumn grand offering to the Lord, with former kings as associates, has a fixed month but no fixed day.
translations.idiomatic: The autumn grand offering to the Lord, with former kings as associates, has a fixed month but no fixed day.

sentences.zh: 禮不卜常祀而卜其日，所謂卜日者，卜其辛爾。

translations.literal: Rites do not divinate for regular sacrifices but divinate the day—what is called divining the day means divining the xin day.
translations.idiomatic: Rites do not require divination for regular sacrifices but do require divination for the day—what is called divining the day means selecting an auspicious xin day.

sentences.zh: 蓋月有上辛、次辛，請以吉辛為正。」

translations.literal: For the month has upper xin and secondary xin—please take an auspicious xin as the standard."
translations.idiomatic: Since each month has an upper xin day and a secondary xin day, we request that an auspicious xin day be chosen."

sentences.zh: 又言：「《周禮》：'祀昊天上帝，則大裘而冕，祀五帝亦如之。

translations.literal: They also said: "The Zhou Rites: 'When sacrificing to August Heaven Supreme Lord, then great fur and miancrown; sacrificing to the Five Emperors likewise.
translations.idiomatic: They also reported: "The Zhou Rites states: 'When sacrificing to August Heaven Supreme Lord, wear great fur and miancrown; when sacrificing to the Five Emperors, do likewise.

sentences.zh: 享先王則袞冕。

translations.literal: Offering to former kings then uses ceremonial robe and miancrown.
translations.idiomatic: When offering to former kings, wear ceremonial robe and miancrown.

sentences.zh: '蓋于大裘舉正位以見配位，於袞冕舉配位以見正位，以天道事之，則舉卑明尊；

translations.literal: For in great fur one presents the principal seat to reveal the associate seat; in ceremonial robe and miancrown one presents the associate seat to reveal the principal seat—treating them with the Way of Heaven, then presenting the humble reveals the honored;
translations.idiomatic: When wearing great fur, one presents the principal seat to reveal the associate seat; when wearing ceremonial robe and miancrown, one presents the associate seat to reveal the principal seat—when treating them by the Way of Heaven, presenting the humble reveals the honored;

sentences.zh: 大裘象道，袞冕象德，明堂以人道享上帝，請服袞冕。

translations.literal: Great fur symbolizes the Way; ceremonial robe and miancrown symbolize virtue; the Bright Hall offers to Supreme Lord by the way of humanity—please wear ceremonial robe and miancrown.
translations.idiomatic: Great fur symbolizes the Way, and ceremonial robe and miancrown symbolize virtue; since the Bright Hall offers to the Supreme Lord through the way of humanity, we request wearing ceremonial robe and miancrown.

sentences.zh: 郊祀正位設蒲越，明堂正配位以莞，蓋取《禮記》所謂'莞簟之安'。

translations.literal: At suburban sacrifice the principal seat uses rush mats; at the Bright Hall principal and associate seats use cattail—taking the Record of Rites' phrase 'the ease of cattail and bamboo mat.'
translations.idiomatic: At suburban sacrifice the principal seat uses rush mats; at the Bright Hall principal and associate seats use cattail, taking the Record of Rites phrase "the ease of cattail and bamboo mat."

sentences.zh: 請明堂正配位並用莞簟。

translations.literal: Please have the Bright Hall principal and associate seats both use cattail and bamboo mats.
translations.idiomatic: We request that the Bright Hall principal and associate seats both use cattail and bamboo mats.

sentences.zh: 又《周禮》：'以蒼璧禮天。

translations.literal: Again the Zhou Rites: 'Use the green bi to honor Heaven.'
translations.idiomatic: The Zhou Rites also states: "Use the green bi to honor Heaven."

sentences.zh: '又曰：'四圭有邸，以祀天，旅上帝。

translations.literal: It also says: 'Four gui with pedestals, to sacrifice to Heaven, and present to Supreme Lord.
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "Four gui with pedestals, to sacrifice to Heaven and present offerings to the Supreme Lord.

sentences.zh: '然說者謂禮神在求神之前，祀神在禮神之後。

translations.literal: Yet commentators say honoring the spirit precedes seeking the spirit, and sacrificing to the spirit follows honoring the spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Yet commentators hold that honoring the spirit comes before seeking the spirit, while sacrificing to the spirit comes after honoring the spirit.

sentences.zh: 蓋一祭而並用也。

translations.literal: For it is one sacrifice using both together.
translations.idiomatic: A single sacrifice uses both together.

sentences.zh: 夏祭方澤，兩圭有邸，與黃琮並用。

translations.literal: Summer sacrifice at the Square Pond uses two gui with pedestals together with the yellow cong.
translations.idiomatic: At the summer sacrifice at the Square Pond, two gui with pedestals are used together with the yellow cong.

sentences.zh: 明堂大享，蒼璧及四圭有邸亦宜並用。

translations.literal: At the Bright Hall grand offering, the green bi and four gui with pedestals should likewise be used together.
translations.idiomatic: At the Bright Hall grand offering, the green bi and four gui with pedestals should likewise be used together.

sentences.zh: 圜丘、方澤，執玄圭則搢大圭，執大圭則奠玄圭。

translations.literal: At the Round Mound and Square Pond, holding the dark gui then insert the great gui; holding the great gui then place the dark gui.
translations.idiomatic: At the Round Mound and Square Pond, when holding the dark gui one inserts the great gui; when holding the great gui one places the dark gui.

sentences.zh: 《禮經》，祀大神祇，享先王，一如明堂親祠，宜如上儀。

translations.literal: The Classic of Rites, sacrificing to great spirits and offering to former kings, all like the Bright Hall personal sacrifice—should follow the above ritual.
translations.idiomatic: In the Classic of Rites, sacrifices to great spirits and offerings to former kings follow the same pattern as personal sacrifice at the Bright Hall and should follow the ritual described above.

sentences.zh: 其正配二位，請各用籩二十六，豆二十六，簠八，簋八，登三，鉶三，柶盤、神位席、幣篚，祝篚、玉爵反坫、瑤爵、牛羊豕鼎各一，並局匕、畢茅、冪俎六，大尊、山尊、著尊、犧尊、象尊各二，壺尊六，皆設而弗酌。

translations.literal: For the principal and associate two positions, please use for each twenty-six bian, twenty-six dou, eight fu, eight gui, three deng, three xing, spoon-trays, spirit-seat mats, silk baskets, invoker baskets, jade goblets with earthen mounds, yao goblets, ox-sheep-pig cauldrons each one, together with tablet spoons, thatch bundles, covered stands six, great vessels, mountain vessels, standing vessels, sacrificial-animal vessels, elephant vessels each two, pot vessels six—all set but not poured.
translations.idiomatic: For the principal and associate positions, we request that each use twenty-six bian, twenty-six dou, eight fu, eight gui, three deng, three xing, spoon-trays, spirit-seat mats, silk baskets, invoker baskets, jade goblets with earthen mounds, yao goblets, and one each of the ox, sheep, and pig cauldrons, together with six tablet spoons, thatch bundles, and covered stands, two each of great, mountain, standing, sacrificial-animal, and elephant vessels, and six pot vessels—all set out but not poured.

sentences.zh: 尊加冪。

translations.literal: The vessels with covers.
translations.idiomatic: The vessels were given covers.

sentences.zh: 犧尊、象尊、壺尊、犧罍、象罍、壺罍各五，加勺、冪。

translations.literal: Sacrificial-animal vessels, elephant vessels, pot vessels, sacrificial-animal jars, elephant jars, and pot jars, five each, with ladles and covers.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial-animal vessels, elephant vessels, pot vessels, sacrificial-animal jars, elephant jars, and pot jars, five each, with ladles and covers added.

sentences.zh: 禦盤匜一，並篚、勺、巾。

translations.literal: One imperial wash basin and ewer, together with baskets, ladles, and towels.
translations.idiomatic: One imperial wash basin and ewer, together with baskets, ladles, and towels.

sentences.zh: 飲福受黍豆一，以玉飾。

translations.literal: One millet cup for receiving blessing wine, jade ornamented.
translations.idiomatic: One millet cup for receiving blessing wine, ornamented with jade.

sentences.zh: 飯福受胙俎一。

translations.literal: One stand for receiving blessing meat after the meal of blessing.
translations.idiomatic: One stand for receiving blessing meat after the meal of blessing.

sentences.zh: 亞獻、終獻盥洗罍、爵洗罍並篚、勺、巾各一，神廚鸞刀一。」

translations.literal: For the secondary and final offerings, hand-washing jars and goblet-washing jars with baskets, ladles, and towels each one, and one divine-kitchen phoenix knife."
translations.idiomatic: For the secondary and final offerings, hand-washing jars and goblet-washing jars, each with one basket, ladle, and towel, and one divine-kitchen phoenix knife."

sentences.zh: 又言：「明堂用牲而不設庶羞之鼎。

translations.literal: They also said: "The Bright Hall uses sacrificial animals but does not set the cauldrons for assorted delicacies.
translations.idiomatic: They also reported: "The Bright Hall uses sacrificial animals but does not set cauldrons for assorted delicacies.

sentences.zh: 按元豐禮，明堂牲牢正配，各用牛一、羊一、豕一。

translations.literal: According to the Yuanfeng rites, for the Bright Hall sacrificial livestock at principal and associate positions, each uses one ox, one sheep, and one pig.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Yuanfeng rites, at the Bright Hall sacrificial livestock for the principal and associate positions, each position uses one ox, one sheep, and one pig.

sentences.zh: 宗祀止用三鼎而不設庶羞之鼎，其俎亦止合用六。

translations.literal: Ancestral sacrifice uses only three cauldrons and does not set cauldrons for assorted delicacies; the stands also use only six in total.
translations.idiomatic: Ancestral sacrifice uses only three cauldrons and does not set cauldrons for assorted delicacies; the stands likewise use only six in total.

sentences.zh: 宗廟祭祀五齊三酒，有設而弗酌者，若酒正所謂'以法共五齊三酒，以實八尊'是也。

translations.literal: Imperial Ancestral Temple sacrifice has five grades of refined liquor and three wines—some set but not poured, as the Director of Wine said 'according to regulation supply the five grades and three wines, to fill eight vessels'—this is such.
translations.idiomatic: In Imperial Ancestral Temple sacrifice there are five grades of refined liquor and three wines—some set out but not poured, as when the Director of Wine says, "According to regulation supply the five grades and three wines to fill eight vessels"—this is such a case.

sentences.zh: 有設而酌者，若司尊彝所謂'醴齊縮酌，盎齊涚酌，凡酒脩酌'是也。

translations.literal: Some set and poured, as the Manager of Vessels said 'li refined liquor strained and poured, ang refined liquor filtered and poured, ordinary wine clarified and poured'—this is such.
translations.idiomatic: Others are set out and poured, as when the Manager of Vessels says, "Li refined liquor is strained and poured, ang refined liquor is filtered and poured, and ordinary wine is clarified and poured"—this is such a case.

sentences.zh: 今太廟、明堂之用，請以大尊實泛齊，山尊實醴齊，著尊實盎齊，犧尊實緹齊，象尊實沉齊，壺尊實三酒，皆為弗酌之尊。

translations.literal: Now for Imperial Ancestral Temple and Bright Hall use, please fill the great vessel with fan refined liquor, mountain vessel with li refined liquor, standing vessel with ang refined liquor, sacrificial-animal vessel with ti refined liquor, elephant vessel with chen refined liquor, pot vessel with the three wines—all as vessels not poured.
translations.idiomatic: For present use at the Imperial Ancestral Temple and Bright Hall, we request that the great vessel be filled with fan refined liquor, the mountain vessel with li refined liquor, the standing vessel with ang refined liquor, the sacrificial-animal vessel with ti refined liquor, the elephant vessel with chen refined liquor, and the pot vessel with the three wines—all as vessels set out but not poured.

sentences.zh: 又以犧尊實醴齊為初獻，象尊實盎齊為亞獻，並陳於阼階之上，犧在西，象在東。

translations.literal: Also use the sacrificial-animal vessel filled with li refined liquor for the initial offering, the elephant vessel filled with ang refined liquor for the secondary offering, both displayed above the east steps—the sacrificial-animal vessel to the west, the elephant vessel to the east.
translations.idiomatic: The sacrificial-animal vessel filled with li refined liquor should serve the initial offering, and the elephant vessel filled with ang refined liquor the secondary offering; both should be displayed above the east steps, with the sacrificial-animal vessel to the west and the elephant vessel to the east.

sentences.zh: 壺尊實清酒為終獻，陳於阼階之下，皆為酌尊。

translations.literal: The pot vessel filled with clear wine for the final offering, displayed below the east steps—all as poured vessels.
translations.idiomatic: The pot vessel filled with clear wine should serve the final offering and be displayed below the east steps—all as vessels from which libations are poured.

sentences.zh: 尊三，其貳以備乏匱。

translations.literal: Three of each vessel, with a second set to guard against shortfall.
translations.idiomatic: Three of each vessel type, with a second set to guard against shortfall.

sentences.zh: 明堂雖嚴父，然配天與上帝，所以求天神而禮之，宜同郊祀，用禮天神六變之樂，以天帝為尊焉。

translations.literal: Although the Bright Hall honors the father, yet associating with Heaven and Supreme Lord is to seek heavenly spirits and honor them—it is appropriate to follow suburban sacrifice, using the six-transformations music for honoring heavenly spirits, with the Heavenly Lord as honored.
translations.idiomatic: Although the Bright Hall honors the father, associating with Heaven and the Supreme Lord is meant to seek heavenly spirits and honor them; it is appropriate to follow suburban sacrifice, using the six-transformations music for honoring heavenly spirits, with the Heavenly Lord as the principal object of honor.

sentences.zh: 皇祐以來，以大慶殿為明堂，奏請致齋於文德殿，禮成，受賀於紫宸殿。

translations.literal: Since Huangyou, using the Great Felicity Hall as the Bright Hall, memorials requesting fasting were submitted at the Wende Hall; when the rites were complete, congratulations were received at the Zichen Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Since Huangyou, when the Great Felicity Hall served as the Bright Hall, memorials requesting fasting were submitted at the Wende Hall; when the rites were complete, congratulations were received at the Zichen Hall.

sentences.zh: 今明堂肇建，宜於大慶殿奏請致齋，於文德殿禮成受賀。

translations.literal: Now that the Bright Hall is newly built, it is appropriate to submit memorials requesting fasting at the Great Felicity Hall, and when the rites are complete receive congratulations at the Wende Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the Bright Hall has been newly built, memorials requesting fasting should be submitted at the Great Felicity Hall, and congratulations should be received at the Wende Hall when the rites are complete.

sentences.zh: 宿齋奏嚴，本以警備。

translations.literal: The overnight-fast strictness drums were originally to warn and prepare.
translations.idiomatic: The overnight-fast strictness drums were originally meant to warn and prepare.

sentences.zh: 仁宗詔明堂直端門，故齋夕權罷。

translations.literal: Emperor Renzong decreed that because the Bright Hall directly faced the Terminal Gate, the evening of fasting drums were temporarily discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Renzong decreed that because the Bright Hall directly faced the Terminal Gate, the evening fasting drums were temporarily discontinued.

sentences.zh: 今明堂在寢東南，不與端門直，將來宗祀，大慶殿齋宿，皇城外不設鹵簿儀仗，其警場請列於大慶殿門之外。

translations.literal: Now the Bright Hall is southeast of the sleeping quarters and does not directly face the Terminal Gate; for future ancestral sacrifice, lodging in fasting at the Great Felicity Hall, outside the imperial city no guard of honor or ceremonial escort will be set; please line the warning ground outside the Great Felicity Hall gate.
translations.idiomatic: Now the Bright Hall lies southeast of the sleeping quarters and does not directly face the Terminal Gate; for future ancestral sacrifice, when lodging in fasting at the Great Felicity Hall, no guard of honor or ceremonial escort will be set outside the imperial city; we request that the warning ground be lined up outside the Great Felicity Hall gate.

sentences.zh: 王者祀上帝於郊，配以祖，祀於明堂，配以禰。

translations.literal: The king sacrifices to Supreme Lord at the suburb, associating the ancestor; sacrifices at the Bright Hall, associating the father.
translations.idiomatic: The king sacrifices to the Supreme Lord in the suburbs, associating the ancestor; he sacrifices at the Bright Hall, associating the father.

sentences.zh: 今有司行事，乃寓端誠殿，未盡禮意。

translations.literal: Now when officials perform the rite, they lodge it in the Duancheng Hall, not fully expressing ritual intent.
translations.idiomatic: Now when officials perform the rite, they lodge it in the Duancheng Hall, which does not fully express the ritual intent.

sentences.zh: 請非親祀歲，有司行事，亦於明堂。

translations.literal: Please have officials perform the rite at the Bright Hall even in years when the emperor does not sacrifice personally.
translations.idiomatic: We request that in years when the emperor does not sacrifice personally, officials performing the rite should also do so at the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 改儀仗使曰禮衛，鹵簿使曰禮器，橋道頓遞使曰禮頓，大禮、禮儀二使仍舊制。

translations.literal: Change the ceremonial escort commissioner to Ritual Guard, the guard-of-honor commissioner to Ritual Vessels, the bridge-road relay commissioner to Ritual Relay; the two commissioners for Great Rites and Ritual Protocol remain under the old system.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremonial escort commissioner should be renamed Ritual Guard, the guard-of-honor commissioner Ritual Vessels, and the bridge-road relay commissioner Ritual Relay; the two commissioners for Great Rites and Ritual Protocol should remain under the old system.

sentences.zh: 又設季秋大享登歌，並用方士。」

translations.literal: Also establish ascending-song for the autumn grand offering, all employing fangshi ritual masters."
translations.idiomatic: Also establish ascending-song for the autumn grand offering, all to be performed by fangshi ritual masters."

sentences.zh: 初，禮部尚書許光凝等議：「明堂五室祀五帝，而王安石以五帝為五精之君，昊天之佐，故分位於五室，與享於明堂。

translations.literal: Initially, Minister of Rites Xu Guangning and others deliberated: "The Bright Hall's five chambers sacrifice to the Five Emperors, while Wang Anshi held the Five Emperors to be lords of the five essences and assistants to August Heaven, therefore dividing positions among the five chambers and sharing the offering at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, Minister of Rites Xu Guangning and others deliberated: "The Bright Hall's five chambers sacrifice to the Five Emperors, while Wang Anshi held the Five Emperors to be lords of the five essences and assistants to August Heaven, and therefore divided their positions among the five chambers to share in the Bright Hall offering.

sentences.zh: 神宗詔唯以英宗配帝，悉去從祀群神。

translations.literal: Emperor Shenzong decreed that only Yingzong should associate with the Lord, removing entirely the attendant sacrifice of the host of spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shenzong decreed that only Yingzong should associate with the Supreme Lord, entirely removing the attendant sacrifice of the host of spirits.

sentences.zh: 陛下肇新宏規，得其時制，位五帝於五室，既無以禰概配之嫌，止祀五帝，又無群神從祀之瀆，則神考絀六天于前，陛下正五室於後，其揆一也。」

translations.literal: Your Majesty newly inaugurates the great plan, obtaining the timely regulation, placing the Five Emperors in the five chambers—there is no suspicion of using the father to stand in as associate; sacrificing only to the Five Emperors, and again no profanation of attendant sacrifice by the host of spirits—then Divine Father abolished the six heavens before, and Your Majesty rectifies the five chambers after; the measure is one."
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty is newly inaugurating the great plan and has obtained the timely regulation by placing the Five Emperors in the five chambers—there is no suspicion of using the father to stand in as associate; by sacrificing only to the Five Emperors, there is again no profanation through attendant sacrifice by the host of spirits; just as Divine Father abolished the six heavens before, Your Majesty rectifies the five chambers after—the measure is one."

sentences.zh: 至是詔罷從祀，而親祠五室焉。

translations.literal: At this time an edict discontinued attendant sacrifice, and he personally sacrificed in the five chambers.
translations.idiomatic: At this time an edict discontinued attendant sacrifice, and the emperor personally sacrificed in the five chambers.

sentences.zh: 尋詔每歲季秋大享，親祠明堂如孟月朝獻禮，罷有司攝事，及五使儀仗等。

translations.literal: Soon an edict ordered that each year's autumn grand offering personally sacrifice at the Bright Hall like the first-month court offering, discontinuing officials acting on behalf and the five commissioners' ceremonial escort and the like.
translations.idiomatic: Soon an edict ordered that each year's autumn grand offering be performed personally at the Bright Hall like the first-month court offering, discontinuing officials acting on the emperor's behalf as well as the five commissioners' ceremonial escort and the like.

sentences.zh: 已而太常寺上《明堂儀》：皇帝散齋七日於別殿，致齋三日於內殿，有司設大次於齋明殿，設小次於明堂東階下。

translations.literal: Then the Court of Imperial Sacrifices submitted the Bright Hall Protocol: the emperor observes general abstinence seven days in a separate hall, concentrated fasting three days in the inner hall; the relevant offices set the great rest pavilion at Fast-Clarity Hall and the small rest pavilion below the Bright Hall's east steps.
translations.idiomatic: Then the Court of Imperial Sacrifices submitted the Bright Hall Protocol: the emperor was to observe general abstinence for seven days in a separate hall and concentrated fasting for three days in the inner hall; the relevant offices were to set the great rest pavilion at Fast-Clarity Hall and the small rest pavilion below the Bright Hall's east steps.

sentences.zh: 祀曰，行事、執事、陪祠官立班殿下，東西相向。

translations.literal: On the day of sacrifice, ritual-performing, assisting, and attendant-sacrifice officials formed ranks below the hall, facing east and west.
translations.idiomatic: On the day of sacrifice, ritual-performing, assisting, and attendant-sacrifice officials formed ranks below the hall, facing east and west.

sentences.zh: 皇帝服袞冕，太常卿、東上閣門官、太常博士前導。

translations.literal: The emperor wore ceremonial robe and miancrown; the Director of Imperial Sacrifices, eastern upper Gatehouse official, and Imperial Sacrifices academician led before.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wore ceremonial robe and miancrown, preceded by the Director of Imperial Sacrifices, an eastern upper Gatehouse official, and an Imperial Sacrifices academician.

sentences.zh: 禮部侍郎奏中嚴外辦，太常卿奏請行禮。

translations.literal: The Vice Minister of Rites announced mid-strictness and outer readiness; the Director of Imperial Sacrifices announced requesting to perform the rite.
translations.idiomatic: The Vice Minister of Rites announced mid-strictness and outer readiness; the Director of Imperial Sacrifices announced a request to perform the rite.

sentences.zh: 太常卿奏禮畢，禮部郎中奏解嚴。

translations.literal: The Director of Imperial Sacrifices announced the rites complete; the Director of the Ministry of Rites announced lifting strictness.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Imperial Sacrifices announced that the rites were complete; the Director of the Ministry of Rites announced that strictness was lifted.

sentences.zh: 其禮器、牲牢、酒饌、奠獻、玉幣、升煙、燔首、祭酒、讀冊、飲福、受胙並樂舞等，並如宗祀明堂儀。

translations.literal: The ritual vessels, sacrificial livestock, wine and food, offerings, jade and silks, ascending smoke, burning heads, libation wine, reading the register, receiving blessing wine, receiving blessing meat, and music and dance—all follow the ancestral Bright Hall sacrifice protocol.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual vessels, sacrificial livestock, wine and food, offerings, jade and silks, ascending smoke, burning of heads, libation wine, reading of the register, receiving blessing wine, receiving blessing meat, and music and dance—all followed the ancestral Bright Hall sacrifice protocol.

sentences.zh: 其行事、執事、陪祠官，並前十日受誓戒於明堂。

translations.literal: The ritual-performing, assisting, and attendant-sacrifice officials all received oath and abstinence at the Bright Hall ten days before.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual-performing, assisting, and attendant-sacrifice officials all received oath and abstinence at the Bright Hall ten days beforehand.

sentences.zh: 行事、執事官致齋三日，前一日並服朝服立班省饌，祀日並祭服。

translations.literal: Ritual-performing and assisting officials observed concentrated fasting three days; the day before all wore court dress and formed ranks to inspect the offerings; on the sacrifice day all wore sacrificial dress.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual-performing and assisting officials observed concentrated fasting for three days; the day before, all wore court dress and formed ranks to inspect the offerings; on the sacrifice day all wore sacrificial dress.

sentences.zh: 陪位官致齋一日。

translations.literal: Attendant officials observed concentrated fasting one day.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant officials observed concentrated fasting for one day.

sentences.zh: 祀前二日仍奏告神宗配侑。

translations.literal: Two days before the sacrifice they still submitted announcement informing that Emperor Shenzong was associate.
translations.idiomatic: Two days before the sacrifice they still submitted an announcement informing that Emperor Shenzong was the associate.

sentences.zh: 自是迄宣和七年，歲皆親祀明堂。

translations.literal: From this until Xuanhe 7, each year he personally sacrificed at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: From this until Xuanhe 7 (1125), the emperor personally sacrificed at the Bright Hall every year.

sentences.zh: 四年，太常寺看詳、國子監丞王普言明堂有未合禮者十一事：其一，謂陶匏用於郊丘，玉爵用於明堂，今茲明堂實兼郊禮，宜用陶匏，他日正宗祀之禮，當奉玉爵。

translations.literal: In year 4, Court of Imperial Sacrifices reviewer and Directorate of Education assistant director Wang Pu said the Bright Hall had eleven matters not conforming to ritual: first, earthenware and gourds are used at the suburban mound, jade goblets at the Bright Hall—now this Bright Hall in fact combines suburban rites, so earthenware and gourds should be used; on another day for the proper ancestral sacrifice rite, jade goblets should be offered.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, Court of Imperial Sacrifices reviewer and Directorate of Education assistant director Wang Pu reported eleven matters in which the Bright Hall rite did not conform to ritual: first, earthenware and gourds are used at the suburban mound and jade goblets at the Bright Hall—now this Bright Hall in fact combines suburban rites, so earthenware and gourds should be used; on another day, for the proper ancestral sacrifice rite, jade goblets should be offered.

sentences.zh: 其二，《禮經》，太牢當以牛、羊、豕為序，今用《我將》之詩，遂以羊、豕、牛為序，所謂以辭害意，豈有用大牲作元祀，而反在羊、豕之後者？

translations.literal: Second, the Classic of Rites: the great offering should follow the order ox, sheep, pig—now using the ode "I Will," they follow sheep, pig, ox—what is called letting words harm meaning; how could the great sacrificial animal used for the primary sacrifice come after sheep and pig?
translations.idiomatic: Second, the Classic of Rites prescribes that the great offering should follow the order of ox, sheep, and pig—now, using the ode "I Will," the order is sheep, pig, and ox—what is called letting words harm meaning; how could the great sacrificial animal used for the primary sacrifice come after the sheep and pig?

sentences.zh: 其三，陳設尊罍，宜仿《周官》司尊彝秋嘗之制。

translations.literal: Third, displaying vessels and jars should follow the autumn offering regulation of the Manager of Vessels in the Offices of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Third, the display of vessels and jars should follow the autumn offering regulation of the Manager of Vessels in the Offices of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 其四，泛齊醴齊，宜代以今酒而不易其名。

translations.literal: Fourth, fan refined liquor and li refined liquor should be replaced with present-day wine without changing their names.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, fan refined liquor and li refined liquor should be replaced with present-day wine without changing their names.

sentences.zh: 其五、其六，祭器、冕服，當從古制。

translations.literal: Fifth and sixth, sacrificial vessels and miancrown dress should follow ancient regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth and sixth, sacrificial vessels and miancrown dress should follow the ancient regulations.

sentences.zh: 其七，皇帝未後詣齋室，則是致齋二日有半，乞用質明以成三日之禮。

translations.literal: Seventh, if the emperor does not afterward proceed to the fasting chamber, then concentrated fasting is two and a half days—please use dawn to complete the three-day rite.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh, if the emperor does not afterward proceed to the fasting chamber, concentrated fasting lasts only two and a half days—we request that dawn be used to complete the three-day rite.

sentences.zh: 其八，齋不飲酒茹葷，乞罷官給酒饌，俾得專心致志，交於神明。

translations.literal: Eighth, during fasting one does not drink wine or eat meat—please discontinue official provision of wine and food, so one may concentrate the mind and commune with the spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth, during fasting one does not drink wine or eat meat—we request that official provision of wine and food be discontinued so that one may concentrate the mind and commune with the spirits.

sentences.zh: 其九，設神位版及升煙、奠冊，不當委之散吏。

translations.literal: Ninth, setting spirit-seat tablets and ascending smoke and laying the register should not be entrusted to low-ranking clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth, setting spirit-seat tablets, ascending smoke, and laying the register should not be entrusted to low-ranking clerks.

sentences.zh: 其十、十一，皆論樂。

translations.literal: Tenth and eleventh both concern music.
translations.idiomatic: The tenth and eleventh both concern music.

sentences.zh: 並從之。

translations.literal: All were adopted.
translations.idiomatic: All were adopted.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，以欽宗之喪，用元祐故事，皆前期朝獻景靈宮、朝享太廟，皆遣大臣攝事；

translations.literal: In year 31, because of mourning for Emperor Qinzong, following the Yuanyou precedent, beforehand court offerings were made at the Jingling Palace and court offerings at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, all with great ministers acting on behalf;
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year, because of mourning for Emperor Qinzong, following the Yuanyou precedent, court offerings were made beforehand at the Jingling Palace and at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, all with great ministers acting on the emperor's behalf;

sentences.zh: 唯親行大享之禮，禮畢宣赦，樂備不作。

translations.literal: Only the grand offering rite was performed personally; when the rites were complete an amnesty was proclaimed; the full music was not performed.
translations.idiomatic: Only the grand offering rite was performed in person; when the rites were complete an amnesty was proclaimed, but the full music was not performed.

sentences.zh: 附廟畢如故事。

translations.literal: After enshrinement in the temple was complete, it followed precedent.
translations.idiomatic: After enshrinement in the temple was complete, the procedure followed precedent.

sentences.zh: 享罷合祭，奉徽宗配。

translations.literal: After the offering was complete came joint sacrifice, presenting Huizong as associate.
translations.idiomatic: After the offering came a joint sacrifice, with Huizong presented as associate.

sentences.zh: 祀五天帝、五人帝於堂上，五官神於東廂，仍罷從祀諸神位，用熙寧禮也。

translations.literal: Sacrificing to the Five Heavenly Emperors and Five Human Emperors on the hall, the Five Official spirits in the east wing, still discontinuing attendant sacrifice of the host of spirit seats—using the Xining rite.
translations.idiomatic: The Five Heavenly Emperors and Five Human Emperors were sacrificed to on the hall, and the Five Official spirits in the east wing; attendant sacrifice of the host of spirit seats was still discontinued, following the Xining rite.

sentences.zh: 孝宗淳熙六年，以群臣議，復合祭天地，並侑祖宗、從祀百神，如南郊。

translations.literal: In Xiaozong's Chunxi 6, on the ministers' deliberation, joint sacrifice of Heaven and Earth was restored, jointly associating ancestors and attendant sacrifice of the hundred spirits, like the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In Xiaozong's Chunxi 6 (1179), on the ministers' deliberation, joint sacrifice of Heaven and Earth was restored, jointly associating the ancestors and attendant sacrifice of the hundred spirits, as at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 十五年九月，有事於明堂，上問宰執配位。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of year 15, there was a ceremony at the Bright Hall; the emperor asked the chief ministers about the associate position.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the fifteenth year, there was a ceremony at the Bright Hall; the emperor asked the chief ministers about the associate position.

sentences.zh: 周必大奏：「昨已申請，高宗几筵未除，用徽宗故事未應配坐，且當以太祖、太宗並配。」

translations.literal: Zhou Bida memorialized: "Yesterday I already submitted request—Gaozong's spirit tablet has not yet been removed; following Huizong's precedent he should not yet take the associate seat; for now Taizu and Taizong should jointly associate."
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Bida memorialized: "I already submitted a request yesterday—Gaozong's spirit tablet has not yet been removed; following Huizong's precedent he should not yet take the associate seat; for now Taizu and Taizong should jointly serve as associates."

sentences.zh: 留正亦言之。

translations.literal: Liu Zheng also spoke thus.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zheng said the same.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「有紹興間典故，可參照無疑。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "There are precedents from the Shaoxing period that can be consulted without doubt."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "There are precedents from the Shaoxing period that can be consulted without doubt."

sentences.zh: 嘉定十七年閏八月，理宗即位，大享當用九月八日，在甯宗梓宮未發之前，下禮官及台諫、兩省詳議。

translations.literal: In the intercalary eighth month of Jiading 17, when Lizong took the throne, the grand offering was to use the eighth day of the ninth month, before Ningzong's coffin had been sent off; ritual officials and censorate remonstrators and the two secretariats were ordered to deliberate in detail.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary eighth month of Jiading 17 (1224), when Lizong took the throne, the grand offering was scheduled for the eighth day of the ninth month, before Ningzong's coffin had been sent off; ritual officials, censorate remonstrators, and the two secretariats were ordered to deliberate in detail.

sentences.zh: 吏部尚書羅點等言：「本朝每三歲一行郊祀，皇祐以來始講明堂之禮，至今遵行。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel Luo Dian and others said: "Our dynasty every three years performs suburban sacrifice; since Huangyou the Bright Hall rite was first instituted, followed to the present.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Personnel Luo Dian and others reported: "Our dynasty performs suburban sacrifice every three years; since Huangyou the Bright Hall rite has been instituted and followed to the present.

sentences.zh: 稽之《禮經》，有'越紼行事'之文，'既殯而祭'之說，則雖未葬以前，可以行事。

translations.literal: Examining the Classic of Rites, there is the text 'cross the mourning cord to perform the rite' and the teaching 'after encoffining then sacrifice'—thus even before burial one may perform the rite.
translations.idiomatic: Examining the Classic of Rites, there is the text "cross the mourning cord to perform the rite" and the teaching "after encoffining, then sacrifice"—thus even before burial one may perform the rite.

sentences.zh: 且紹熙五年九月，在孝宗以日易月釋服之後，未發引之前；

translations.literal: Moreover, in the ninth month of Shaoxi 5, it was after Xiaozong's release from mourning by substituting days for months, before the coffin was sent off;
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, in the ninth month of Shaoxi 5 (1194), it came after Xiaozong's release from mourning by substituting days for months and before the coffin was sent off;

sentences.zh: 慶元六年九月，亦在光宗以日易月釋服之後，未發引之前。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of Qingyuan 6, likewise after Guangzong's release from mourning by substituting days for months, before the coffin was sent off.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Qingyuan 6 (1200), likewise after Guangzong's release from mourning by substituting days for months and before the coffin was sent off.

sentences.zh: 今來九月八日，前祀十日，皇帝散齋別殿，百官各受誓戒，系在閏八月二十七日，即當在以日易月未釋服之內。

translations.literal: Now the eighth day of the ninth month, ten days before the sacrifice, the emperor's general abstinence in a separate hall and the hundred officials each receiving oath and abstinence fall on the twenty-seventh day of the intercalary eighth month—that is, within the period of substituting days for months before release from mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Now the eighth day of the ninth month, ten days before the sacrifice—the emperor's general abstinence in a separate hall and the officials' receipt of oath and abstinence fall on the twenty-seventh day of the intercalary eighth month, that is, within the period of substituting days for months before release from mourning.

sentences.zh: 乞下太史局，於九月內擇次辛日行禮，則在釋服之後，正與前史相同。」

translations.literal: Please order the Directorate of Astronomy to choose a secondary xin day within the ninth month to perform the rite—then it would be after release from mourning, exactly matching previous records."
translations.idiomatic: We request that the Directorate of Astronomy be ordered to choose a secondary xin day within the ninth month for the rite—then it would come after release from mourning, exactly matching previous records."

sentences.zh: 乃用九月二十八日辛卯。

translations.literal: Then the twenty-eighth day of the ninth month, xinmao, was used.
translations.idiomatic: The twenty-eighth day of the ninth month, xinmao, was then chosen.

sentences.zh: 前二日，朝獻景靈宮，前一日，享太廟，遣官攝事。

translations.literal: Two days before, court offering at the Jingling Palace; one day before, offering at the Imperial Ancestral Temple—officials were dispatched to act on behalf.
translations.idiomatic: Two days before, a court offering was made at the Jingling Palace; one day before, an offering at the Imperial Ancestral Temple—officials were dispatched to act on the emperor's behalf.

sentences.zh: 皇帝親行大享，禮成不賀。

translations.literal: The emperor personally performed the grand offering; when the rites were complete congratulations were not offered.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor personally performed the grand offering; when the rites were complete, no congratulations were offered.

sentences.zh: 淳祐三年，將作少監、權樞密都承旨韓祥言：「竊以明堂之禮，累聖不廢嚴父配侑之典。

translations.literal: In Chunyou 3, Assistant Director of Palace Construction and Acting Director of the Privy Council Secretariat Han Xiang said: "I venture that the Bright Hall rite—successive sages have not abolished the canon of honoring the father as associate.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunyou 3 (1243), Assistant Director of Palace Construction and Acting Director of the Privy Council Secretariat Han Xiang said: "I venture that in the Bright Hall rite, successive sages have never abolished the canon of honoring the father as associate.

sentences.zh: 南渡以來，事頗不同。

translations.literal: Since the crossing south, matters have been rather different.
translations.idiomatic: Since the crossing south, matters have been rather different.

sentences.zh: 高廟中興，徽宗北狩，當時合祭天地於明堂，以太祖、太宗配，非廢嚴父之祀，以父在故也。

translations.literal: When Gaozong restored the dynasty, Huizong was on the northern hunt; at that time Heaven and Earth were jointly sacrificed at the Bright Hall with Taizu and Taizong as associates—not abolishing the rite of honoring the father, because the father was still alive.
translations.idiomatic: When Gaozong restored the dynasty, Huizong was on the northern hunt; at that time Heaven and Earth were jointly sacrificed at the Bright Hall with Taizu and Taizong as associates—not because the rite of honoring the father was abolished, but because the father was still alive.

sentences.zh: 及紹興末，乃以徽廟配。

translations.literal: By the end of Shaoxing, Huizong's temple was made associate.
translations.idiomatic: By the end of Shaoxing, Huizong's temple was made associate.

sentences.zh: 孝宗在位二十八年，娛奉堯父，故無祀父之典，南郊、明堂，惟以太祖、太宗配，沿襲至今，遂使陛下追孝甯考之心有所未盡。」

translations.literal: Xiaozong was on the throne twenty-eight years, honoring his father like Yao—thus there was no rite of sacrificing to the father; at Southern Suburb and Bright Hall only Taizu and Taizong were associates, followed to today, so Your Majesty's mind of pursuing filial piety toward Ningzong has something unfulfilled."
translations.idiomatic: Xiaozong reigned twenty-eight years, honoring his father like Yao—thus there was no rite of sacrificing to the father; at the Southern Suburb and Bright Hall only Taizu and Taizong served as associates, a practice followed to the present, so Your Majesty's filial devotion toward Ningzong remains incompletely expressed."

sentences.zh: 時朝散大夫康熙亦援倪思所著合宮嚴父為言。

translations.literal: At the time Court Gentleman Kang Xi also cited Ni Si's writings on the Bright Hall and honoring the father.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Court Gentleman Kang Xi also cited Ni Si's writings on the Bright Hall and honoring the father.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「三後並侑之說最當。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "The proposal for three ancestors jointly as associates is most appropriate."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "The proposal for three ancestors jointly as associates is most appropriate."

sentences.zh: 是後明堂以太祖、太宗、甯宗並侑。

translations.literal: Thereafter at the Bright Hall Taizu, Taizong, and Ningzong were jointly associates.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter at the Bright Hall Taizu, Taizong, and Ningzong served jointly as associates.

sentences.zh: 寶祐五年九月辛酉，復奉高宗升侑。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, xinyou day, of Baoyou 5, Gaozong was again elevated as associate.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, xinyou day, of Baoyou 5 (1257), Gaozong was again elevated as associate.

sentences.zh: 於是明堂之禮，一祖三宗並配。

translations.literal: Thus in the Bright Hall rite, one founder-ancestor and three lineage-ancestors were jointly associates.
translations.idiomatic: Thus in the Bright Hall rite, one founder-ancestor and three lineage-ancestors served jointly as associates.

sentences.zh: 度宗鹹淳五年，明堂大享，又去甯宗，奉理宗與祖宗並配。

translations.literal: In Duzong's Xianchun 5, the Bright Hall grand offering again removed Ningzong and elevated Lizong jointly with the ancestors as associates.
translations.idiomatic: In Duzong's Xianchun 5 (1269), at the Bright Hall grand offering Ningzong was again removed and Lizong elevated jointly with the ancestors as associates.

sentences.zh: 先是，紹興初，權禮部尚書胡直孺等言：「國朝配祀，自英宗始配以近考，司馬光、呂誨爭之，以為詘祖進父，然卒不能奪王珪、孫抃之諂辭。

translations.literal: Earlier, at the beginning of Shaoxing, Acting Minister of Rites Hu Zhiru and others said: "Our dynasty's associate sacrifices—from Yingzong began associating with the recent father; Sima Guang and Lu Hui contested this, holding it demeaned the ancestors to elevate the father, yet in the end could not overturn Wang Gui and Sun Bian's flattery.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, at the beginning of Shaoxing, Acting Minister of Rites Hu Zhiru and others said: "Our dynasty's associate sacrifices—from Yingzong onward the recent father was made associate; Sima Guang and Lu Hui contested this as demeaning the ancestors to elevate the father, yet could not overturn Wang Gui and Sun Bian's flattery.

sentences.zh: 其後，神宗謂周公守祀在成王之世，成王以文王為祖，則明堂非以考配明矣。

translations.literal: Afterward, Shenzong said the Duke of Zhou maintained sacrifice in King Cheng's age; King Cheng took King Wen as ancestor—thus the Bright Hall is clearly not associating with the father.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward, Shenzong said the Duke of Zhou maintained sacrifice in King Cheng's age; King Cheng took King Wen as ancestor—thus it is clear the Bright Hall does not associate with the father.

sentences.zh: 王安石亦對以誤引《孝經》嚴父之說，惜乎當時無有辨正之者。

translations.literal: Wang Anshi also responded by mistakenly citing the Classic of Filial Piety's theory of honoring the father—alas, at that time there was no one to correct it.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi also responded by mistakenly citing the Classic of Filial Piety's theory of honoring the father—alas, at that time there was no one to correct it.

sentences.zh: 今或者曰：後稷為周之祖，文王、武王是為二祧。

translations.literal: Now some say: Hou Ji was Zhou's ancestor; King Wen and King Wu are the two lineage-ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: Now some say: Hou Ji was Zhou's ancestor; King Wen and King Wu are the two lineage-ancestors.

sentences.zh: 高祖為漢之祖，孝文、孝武特崇兩廟。

translations.literal: Gaozu was Han's ancestor; Emperor Wen and Emperor Wu specially honored the two temples.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu was Han's ancestor; Emperor Wen and Emperor Wu specially honored the two temples.

sentences.zh: 皆子孫世世所奉承者。

translations.literal: All are what descendants generation after generation uphold.
translations.idiomatic: All are what descendants generation after generation uphold.

sentences.zh: 太祖為帝者祖，太宗、真宗宜為帝者宗。

translations.literal: Taizu is the founder-ancestor of emperors; Taizong and Zhenzong should be the lineage-ancestors of emperors.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu is the founder-ancestor of emperors; Taizong and Zhenzong should be the lineage-ancestors of emperors.

sentences.zh: 皇祐以一祖二宗並配，議出於此。

translations.literal: Huangyou used one founder-ancestor and two lineage-ancestors jointly as associates—the deliberation arose from this.
translations.idiomatic: Huangyou used one founder-ancestor and two lineage-ancestors jointly as associates—the deliberation arose from this.

sentences.zh: 直孺等聞前漢以高祖配天，後漢以光武配明堂，蓋古之帝王非建邦啟土者，皆無配之祭。

translations.literal: Zhiru and others heard that Former Han used Gaozu to associate with Heaven, Later Han Guangwu at the Bright Hall—for ancient emperors who did not found the state and open the territory, all lacked associate sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Zhiru and others noted that Former Han associated Gaozu with Heaven and Later Han Guangwu at the Bright Hall—for ancient emperors who did not found the state and open its territory, all lacked associate sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 故雖周之成、康，漢之文、景、明、章，其德業非不美也，然而子孫不敢推以配天者，避祖宗也。

translations.literal: Therefore although Zhou's Cheng and Kang, Han's Wen, Jing, Ming, and Zhang—their merit and accomplishment were not lacking in beauty—yet descendants did not dare promote them to associate with Heaven, deferring to the ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore although Zhou's Cheng and Kang, and Han's Wen, Jing, Ming, and Zhang had merit and accomplishment of no small beauty, descendants did not dare promote them to associate with Heaven, deferring to their ancestors.

sentences.zh: 有宋肇基創業之君，太祖是已。

translations.literal: Song's ruler who founded the base and created the enterprise—Taizu is he.
translations.idiomatic: Song's ruler who founded the base and created the enterprise was Taizu.

sentences.zh: 太祖則周之後稷，配祭於郊者也；

translations.literal: Taizu is Zhou's Hou Ji, associating at the suburban sacrifice;
translations.idiomatic: Taizu is Zhou's Hou Ji, associating at the suburban sacrifice;

sentences.zh: 太宗則周之文王，配祭於明堂者也。

translations.literal: Taizong is Zhou's King Wen, associating at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong is Zhou's King Wen, associating at the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 此二祭者，萬世不遷之法。

translations.literal: These two sacrifices are the law unchanging for ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: These two sacrifices are the law unchanging for ten thousand generations.

sentences.zh: 皇祐宗祀，合祭天地，固宜以太祖、太宗配。

translations.literal: Huangyou's ancestral sacrifice jointly sacrificed Heaven and Earth—it was fitting to use Taizu and Taizong as associates.
translations.idiomatic: Huangyou's ancestral sacrifice jointly sacrificed Heaven and Earth—it was fitting to use Taizu and Taizong as associates.

sentences.zh: 當時蓋拘于嚴父，故配帝並及于真宗。

translations.literal: At that time they were bound by honoring the father, so the associate with the Lord also reached Zhenzong.
translations.idiomatic: At that time they were bound by honoring the father, so the associate with the Lord also included Zhenzong.

sentences.zh: 今主上紹膺大統，自真宗至於神宗均為祖廟，獨躋則患在於無名，並配則幾同於袷享。

translations.literal: Now Your Majesty has succeeded to the great succession; from Zhenzong to Shenzong all are ancestral temples—elevating one alone would worry over lacking a name; joint association would nearly equal a combined seasonal offering.
translations.idiomatic: Now Your Majesty has succeeded to the great succession; from Zhenzong to Shenzong all are ancestral temples—elevating one alone would lack proper designation; joint association would nearly equal a combined seasonal offering.

sentences.zh: 今參酌皇祐詔書，請合祭昊天上帝、皇地祇於明堂，奉太祖、太宗以配，惟禮專而事簡，庶幾可以致力於神，萬世行之可也。」

translations.literal: Now weighing Huangyou's edict, we request jointly sacrificing August Heaven Supreme Lord and Imperial Earth Almighty at the Bright Hall, presenting Taizu and Taizong as associates—only the rite is focused and the affair simple, perhaps able to devote effort to the spirits; it may be practiced for ten thousand generations."
translations.idiomatic: Now weighing Huangyou's edict, we request jointly sacrificing August Heaven Supreme Lord and Imperial Earth Almighty at the Bright Hall, with Taizu and Taizong as associates—only the rite is focused and the affair simple, so effort may be devoted to the spirits; it may be practiced for ten thousand generations."

sentences.zh: 七年，徽宗哀聞。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Huizong's mourning was announced.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, Huizong's death was announced.

sentences.zh: 是歲九月，中書舍人傅崧卿援嚴父之說，不幸太上諱問奄至，而大享不及，理實未安。

translations.literal: That year in the ninth month, Drafting Edict Attendant Fu Songqing cited the theory of honoring the father; unhappily the Retired Emperor's taboo inquiry suddenly arrived, and the grand offering could not be completed—in reason and fact this was unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: That year in the ninth month, Drafting Edict Attendant Fu Songqing cited the theory of honoring the father; unhappily news of the Retired Emperor's death suddenly arrived, and the grand offering could not be completed—in reason and fact this was unsettling.

sentences.zh: 吏部尚書孫近等言：「元年以來，祖、宗並配，今論者乃欲祖、宗並配之外，增道君皇帝一位，不合典禮。」

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel Sun Jin and others said: "Since the first year, ancestors and lineage-ancestors have been jointly associates; now deliberators wish beyond joint ancestors and lineage-ancestors to add the Daoist Lord Emperor one position—this does not accord with canonical ritual."
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Personnel Sun Jin and others said: "Since the first year, ancestors and lineage-ancestors have served jointly as associates; now deliberators wish beyond them to add the Daoist Lord Emperor—this does not accord with canonical ritual."

sentences.zh: 權禮部侍郎陳公輔言：「今梓宮未還，廟社未定，疆土未復，臣竊意祖宗、上皇神靈所望于陛下者，必欲興衰撥亂，恢復中原，迎還梓宮，歸藏陵寢，以隆我宋無疆之業。

translations.literal: Acting Vice Minister of Rites Chen Gongfu said: "Now the imperial coffin has not returned, the altars of state are not settled, the territory is not restored—I venture that what the ancestors and Retired Emperor's spirits hope from Your Majesty must be to revive the declining and settle disorder, restore the Central Plains, welcome back the imperial coffin, return it to the mausoleum, and elevate Song's boundless enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: Acting Vice Minister of Rites Chen Gongfu said: "Now the imperial coffin has not returned, the altars of state are unsettled, the territory is unrestored—I venture that what the ancestors and the Retired Emperor's spirits hope from Your Majesty is to revive the declining and settle disorder, restore the Central Plains, welcome back the imperial coffin, return it to the mausoleum, and elevate Song's boundless enterprise.

sentences.zh: 若如議者之言，以陛下貴為天子，上皇北狩十有一年，未獲天下之養，今不幸而崩，且欲因明堂之禮，追配上帝，謂是足以盡人子之孝，則于陛下之志，恐亦小矣。

translations.literal: If as the deliberators say—Your Majesty honored as Son of Heaven, the Retired Emperor on the northern hunt eleven years without receiving the realm's support, now unhappily deceased, and wishing through the Bright Hall rite to posthumously associate with Supreme Lord, holding this sufficient to fulfill a son's filial piety—then toward Your Majesty's aspiration, I fear it is also small.
translations.idiomatic: If as deliberators say—Your Majesty honored as Son of Heaven while the Retired Emperor was on the northern hunt eleven years without receiving the realm's support, now unhappily deceased, and wishing through the Bright Hall rite to posthumously associate with the Supreme Lord, holding this sufficient to fulfill a son's filial piety—then toward Your Majesty's true aspiration, I fear it falls short.

sentences.zh: 宜依故事合祭天地，祖、宗並侑。

translations.literal: It is appropriate to follow precedent and jointly sacrifice Heaven and Earth, with ancestors and lineage-ancestors jointly as associates.
translations.idiomatic: It is appropriate to follow precedent and jointly sacrifice Heaven and Earth, with ancestors and lineage-ancestors jointly as associates.

sentences.zh: 太上升配，似未可行。」

translations.literal: Elevating the Retired Emperor as associate seems not yet feasible."
translations.idiomatic: Elevating the Retired Emperor as associate seems not yet feasible."

sentences.zh: 至嘉定四年，遂以太祖、太宗、高宗、甯宗並侑，至度宗，復以太祖、太宗、高宗、理宗並配焉。

translations.literal: By Jiading 4, Taizu, Taizong, Gaozong, and Ningzong were jointly associates; by Duzong's time, again Taizu, Taizong, Gaozong, and Lizong were jointly associates.
translations.idiomatic: By Jiading 4 (1211), Taizu, Taizong, Gaozong, and Ningzong served jointly as associates; by Duzong's time, again Taizu, Taizong, Gaozong, and Lizong served jointly as associates.
